The Internship program at ADI provides young professionals with the opportunity to gain professional experience within an innovative and global company. ADI’s long-term goal is to convert an intern into a full-time employee. The University Relations Team continually strives to accomplish this goal year-after-year by establishing a well-equipped program (virtual and in person) that focuses on growth, company culture, and mentorship, coupled with a collaborative work environment and passion for innovation. On average, each year, ADI converts roughly 70%-80% of their interns into full time hires!
ADI provides a high-quality internship program for which the company has consistently been known. These events involve cross-collaboration with peers, including executive speakers, lab tours, development events, social events, and community service opportunities. Our Intern Program provides an opportunity for interns to collaborate and learn, drive results, and grow their professional network. Apply now for the opportunity to start your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible!
The device modeling team is seeking a motivated, experienced device modeling intern to provide support to our Corporate Engineering Division located at ADI’s Bangalore, India. Our team has about 18 members in different ADI locations. We are talented engineers from diverse cultural backgrounds. Device modeling team is the bridge between the process team and circuit designers. We make career growth from both sides in ADI.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Develop semiconductor device compact models for the SPICE simulator.
- Correlate the device compact model with measurement data.
- Resolve convergence issues during circuit simulation.
- Develop programming scripts to automate the extraction and report generation process.
- Make a comprehensive report to summarize his/her work.
Minimum Qualifications
- M.Tech/ME degree emphasizing semiconductor devices, device models, and/or circuit design.
- Pursuing a Ph.D. in the field of Semiconductor Device Physics, Characterization, and Modeling
- Strong analytical skills, execution mindset, and sense of urgency
Preferred Qualifications
- Familiar with semiconductor device characterization
- Knows Python, Verilog-A Programming

Passion for pushing India’s leadership in foundation model research.",https://saigroup.ai/,"This role is ideal for researchers who have contributed to multimodal alignment, cross-lingual VLMs, document understanding, or Indian-language foundation models, and are excited to bring those innovations into 3D reasoning and semantic grounding.",,0,0,False,1770893496000,1772616600000.0,1772616600000.0,1770893700000.0,"About the Role:

We are building the next generation of multimodal foundation models that unify 3D volumetric data and natural language understanding. Our work extends beyond traditional 2D vision–language models (e.g., CLIP, LLaVA, SigLIP, Chitrarth, Patram) into models that can reason over, align, and generate insights from complex 3D structures, including scientific, medical, geospatial, and industrial volumes.

This role is ideal for researchers who have contributed to multimodal alignment, cross-lingual VLMs, document understanding, or Indian-language foundation models, and are excited to bring those innovations into 3D reasoning and semantic grounding.

You will help define a new class of models at the frontier of AI. 

What You Will Work On - 

Design and train 3D–text foundation models capable of interpreting MRI/CT/voxel grids, LiDAR cubes, or multi-view 3D data paired with textual descriptions.
Extend concepts from CLIP-style contrastive learning, vision encoders, multilingual encoders, and instruction tuning to volumetric domains.
Develop architectures that align 3D latent representations with language embeddings from multilingual LLMs.
Create novel multimodal datasets, including synthetic 3D volumes, annotated natural-language corpora, and domain-specific ontologies.
Publish at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, EMNLP, ACL) and collaborate with universities and research partners.
Push the frontier on cross-lingual multimodal grounding, making 3D understanding accessible across India’s linguistic diversity.
Work with product teams to translate foundational breakthroughs into real-world applications in healthcare, robotics, manufacturing, and scientific discovery.

Why This Role Appeals to Multimodal + CLIP Authors

Opportunity to extend 2D multimodal learning to 3D, a wide-open research space.
Freedom to experiment with contrastive learning, cross-modal retrieval, tokenization strategies for volumes, and multilingual conditioning.
Work with a team that values publication, benchmark building, and open science, similar to CM-CLIP, Chitrarth, or Patram ecosystems.
Direct impact on creating the first India-built 3D multimodal foundation model.
Access to high-compute clusters (A100/H100), data partnerships, and funding for ambitious long-horizon research.
 
What We’re Looking For

Research experience in multimodal learning, transformers, contrastive vision–language models, or LLM fine-tuning.
Demonstrated contributions to CLIP-like, VLM, document understanding, Indian-language foundation models, or multilingual NLP.
Strong skills in PyTorch/JAX, huggingface ecosystems, and large-scale training.
Experience with (or desire to learn) 3D data representations: voxels, meshes, NeRFs, point clouds, medical imaging, or multi-view embeddings.
Ability to build and articulate research hypotheses, run ablations, and produce clear publications.
Passion for pushing India’s leadership in foundation model research.
 
Nice to Have

Background in 3D geometry, 3D CNNs, diffusion models, or implicit neural representations.
Experience with Indian languages, code-mixed data, or multilingual VLMs.
Prior work with weakly supervised or noisy multimodal datasets.
Contributions to open-source multimodal libraries or benchmarks.

1. Job Summary
Responsible for architecting, implementing, and governing enterprise digital platforms and automation initiatives across business functions. The role focuses on translating business requirements into scalable digital solutions, ensuring system stability, integration, user adoption, data integrity, and compliance. This position acts as the central bridge between business stakeholders, IT teams, and external technology partners to deliver robust, future-ready digital ecosystems that support organizational growth and operational excellence.
1.1 Reports to: AVP / AGM Digital
1.2 Direct Reportees: Digital Analysts / Application Owners / Project-based Technical & Functional Coordinators
1.3 Working Relationships
Internal: Business Operations, Marketing & Exports, HR, Finance, SCM, Manufacturing, IAD, Safety, Admin, Corporate Communications External: Software Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud & Automation Partners, Consultants, Auditors
   2. Key Responsibilities
• Lead design, deployment, and enhancement of enterprise digital solutions including CRM, LMS, DMS, workflow automation, and internal portals.
• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of digital platforms—from requirement gathering and solution design to deployment, stabilization, and optimization.
• Act as primary business and technical SPOC for Salesforce, SAP-integrated applications, and other enterprise systems.
• Drive automation of manual and semi-manual processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and turnaround time.
• Ensure seamless integration between SAP, CRM, HRMS, LMS, IAD, and other core systems.
• Govern UAT cycles, release management, and post-go-live stabilization for all digital initiatives.
• Monitor system adoption, user behavior, data quality, and compliance with defined digital processes.
• Define and enforce digital governance frameworks, access controls, and data security standards.
• Collaborate with business teams to identify digital improvement opportunities aligned with strategic objectives.
• Prepare functional specifications, BRDs, FSDs, and solution architecture documents.
• Manage vendor performance, SLAs, SoWs, and commercial alignment for digital solutions.
• Ensure platforms are audit-ready with proper documentation, logs, and compliance alignment.
• Support leadership dashboards, analytics, and MIS systems for data-driven decision-making.
• Stay updated on emerging digital technologies and recommend innovations relevant to the organization.

• BE / BTech / MCA / MBA (Systems, IT, Operations, or equivalent)
• 7–12 years of experience in Digital Solutions, Enterprise Applications, or IT Business Partnering roles

• Stakeholder & Vendor Management
• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Change Management & Digital Adoption
• Risk Management & Compliance Focus
• Strong Analytical & Communication Skills
• Execution Discipline & Ownership Mindset

Position Overview:
As an AI Scientist at Wipro Innovation Network, you will work on next-generation AI systems — from generative models and LLMs to agentic AI, multimodal learning, and advanced optimization techniques.
You will experiment, prototype, and build AI systems that solve real-world problems across industries, collaborating with researchers, engineers, and product teams.
This role gives you exposure to research-grade models, large datasets, AI frameworks, and WIN Labs’ frontier-tech ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
• Build and experiment with AI/ML models: LLMs, SLMs, generative models, NLP, CV, and multi-modal AI.
• Develop algorithms and prototypes to solve real-world problems across different domains.
• Train and fine-tune models on large datasets; experiment with optimizations to improve performance.
• Work on agentic AI workflows: tool-using agents, retrieval, planning, reasoning, multi-agent orchestration.
• Translate business problems into scalable AI/ML solutions with guidance from senior engineers.
• Explore approaches for AI safety, robustness, red-teaming, & alignment.
• Contribute to internal IP, accelerators, or experiments.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate models into production-grade systems.
• Stay updated on the latest AI research trends and apply them in experiments.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, probability, statistics, and linear algebra.
• Solid programming skills in Python; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) is ideal.
• Coursework or project experience in:
o Machine Learning
o Deep Learning
o Natural Language Processing
o Computer Vision
• Familiarity with Transformers, LLM architectures, attention mechanisms, or generative AI concepts.
• Basic understanding of cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) and distributed computing.
• Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
• Curiosity to explore research papers, experiment with ideas, and build prototypes.
Preferred Attributes
• Experience from internships, ML competitions (Kaggle), research labs, or college robotics/AI clubs.
• Understanding of:
o Reinforcement learning
o Multi-agent systems
o Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
o LangChain or similar frameworks
• Exposure to LLM fine-tuning, quantization, optimization, or prompt engineering.
• Experience with GitHub, open-source contributions, or personal AI projects..

Position Overview
Wipro Innovation Network labs Robotics & Embodied AI team to work at the intersection of computer vision, sensor fusion, and autonomous robotic systems. As a Robotics Research Engineer you will build and experiment with perception algorithms, multi-sensor pipelines, and visual-language–action (VLA) models to power next-gen autonomous robots.
This role gives you access to robotic simulators, multi-modal datasets, real-world robotic platforms, and mentorship from senior researchers.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop perception algorithms for detection, tracking, segmentation, SLAM, and scene understanding.
• Work with multi-modal sensor data: camera, LiDAR, radar, IMU.
• Build and test perception models in robotic simulators (e.g., Isaac Sim, Gazebo) and real robotic platforms.
• Integrate perception modules with planning, control, and manipulation systems.
• Explore Visual–Language–Action (VLA) models and multi-modal AI for robotics tasks.
• Collaborate with engineers and researchers across AI, hardware, and controls.
• Implement and optimise algorithms in Python / C++, on Linux/Ubuntu environments.
Explore and contribute to experiments in robot autonomy and embodied intelligence.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS, Robotics, ECE, EE, or related fields.
• Strong programming skills in Python (C++ is a plus).
• Good understanding of Computer vision fundamentals
• Deep learning basics (PyTorch/TensorFlow)
• SLAM, sensor fusion, or VIO concepts
• Familiarity with Linux/Ubuntu and basic command line workflows.
• Curiosity and foundational exposure to robotics platforms or simulations (course projects acceptable).
• Ability to analyse data, debug perception pipelines, and improve model performance.
• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to experiment.
Preferred Attributes
• Experience with ROS (Robot Operating System).
• Exposure to robotic simulators (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, Webots).
• Academic or personal projects in computer vision, robotics, or multi-modal AI.
• Participation in robotics clubs, competitions, hackathons (e.g., e-Yantra, RoboSub, DRDO challenges).
• Understanding of LiDAR/IMU data processing.
• Interest in embodied AI, VLA models, and robot autonomy.

Position Overview
The world is moving beyond Web2, and decentralized systems now power the next era of trust and transparency. As a Distributed Ledger & Blockchain Engineer, you will design and build smart contracts, prototypes, and scalable consensus systems that redefine secure information exchange at a global scale.
Key Responsibilities
• Design and prototype distributed ledger architectures for secure data exchange and transaction traceability.
• Develop smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps) using Ethereum, Hyperledger, or Solana ecosystems.
• Implement cryptographic primitives such as zero-knowledge proofs, Merkle trees, and hash-based consensus mechanisms.
• Build interoperability bridges and APIs between blockchain networks and enterprise systems.
• Create scripts and monitoring tools for node performance, consensus stability, and chain analytics.
• Research and test scalable consensus protocols (PoS, BFT, DAGs) for performance and resilience.
• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to audit contract logic, prevent exploits, and ensure transaction integrity.
• Experiment with tokenization, verifiable credentials, identity solutions, and supply chain traceability models.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals, distributed systems, or cryptography.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Solidity, Go, Rust, TypeScript, or Python.
• Familiarity with blockchain frameworks (Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Solana, Avalanche).
• Knowledge of consensus tools (Tendermint, Raft, HotStuff) and smart contract development tools (Truffle, Hardhat, Remix).
• Ability to work with data and analytics tools like IPFS, The Graph, Prometheus, and Grafana.
• Understanding of security and cryptographic concepts (zk-SNARKs, elliptic curve cryptography).
Preferred Attributes
• Innovative mindset with a passion for decentralized technologies.
• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to experiment.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a research-driven environment.
• Interest in open-source contributions and emerging blockchain trends.
Commitment to building secure, transparent, and fair digital ecosystems.

Position Overview
This role sits at the intersection of AI safety, cybersecurity, and research, offering hands-on experience in evaluating and securing advanced AI systems. You’ll experiment, prototype, and push boundaries while learning from industry mentors. The focus is on building defenses, analyzing vulnerabilities, and contributing to the development of safe and ethical AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
• Run AI safety evaluations, adversarial testing, and red-teaming on LLMs and multimodal AI systems.
• Build tools and defenses against prompt injections, hallucinations, and unsafe model behaviors.
• Prototype quantum-safe cryptography and post-quantum security solutions for next-generation systems.
• Analyze vulnerabilities across AI pipelines—from model training and data ingestion to API access and deployment.
• Collaborate with cybersecurity and privacy teams to validate model reliability, fairness, and privacy guarantees.
• Develop automation and dashboards to monitor model performance, drift, and security health in real time.
• Research emerging AI-driven cyber threats and publish internal insights or contribute to open research forums.
• Participate in capture-the-flag (CTF) inspired AI red teams and safety simulation hackathons.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Strong coding skills (Python, C++, or similar).
• Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and MLOps tools (TensorFlow Extended, Hugging Face Hub, Azure ML).
• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and tools (OWASP, Burp Suite, Metasploit).
• Knowledge of quantum-safe cryptography and post-quantum security standards (CRYSTALS-Kyber, NIST PQC).
• Ability to work with automation and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) and monitoring dashboards (Grafana, Prometheus).
• Comfort with adversarial testing, vulnerability analysis, and secure API practices.
Preferred Attributes
• Curiosity about AI ethics and security challenges.
• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to experiment in uncertain environments.
• Passion for learning and contributing to cutting-edge research.
• Collaborative mindset and ability to thrive in team-based hackathons or red-team exercises.
• Interest in publishing research or contributing to open-source security tools

Greetings from Molecular Connections!

Molecular Connections is hiring chemistry graduates from NIT and other tier 1 institutes for a high impact Scientific Analyst role in our AI driven chemistry data team, with 35 openings, flexible work options (onsite/hybrid/remote).

About Molecular Connections
Molecular Connections is a leading AI/ML driven data science and content solutions company partnering with global leaders in scholarly publishing, STEM, and pharma.

Headquartered in Bengaluru with multiple delivery centres across South India, the company has over two decades of experience in structuring scientific information using proprietary AI models and knowledge graphs.

What You Will Do

Transform experimental chemistry data from journals and patents into structured, searchable knowledge powering our chemistry intelligence platforms.

Extract, interpret, and curate reactions, substances, and property data, and annotate them using internal curation tools and cheminformatics systems (e.g., SMILES, InChI, structure editors).

Ensure accuracy, consistency, and standardization of data across multiple sources to build high quality chemistry databases used by scientists worldwide.

Stay updated on evolving chemical databases, data standards, and digital chemistry trends, while collaborating with cross functional experts in data science and product.

Who Should Apply

Master’s degree (or Integrated M.Sc.) in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or closely related fields from NITs, IISERs, IITs, and other tier 1 institutes.

Strong understanding of organic and inorganic chemistry, reaction mechanisms, and physicochemical/biological properties of compounds, with the ability to interpret primary literature and patents.

Added advantages (not mandatory): Familiarity with cheminformatics concepts/tools (SMILES, InChI, structure editors), basic coding/scripting, or exposure to chemical databases.

Detail oriented, systematic approach to scientific information, with strong written and verbal communication skills for accurate documentation of insights.

Process Equipment Design & Modular Manufacturing
Leumas · Bengaluru
Compensation - 15 LPA to 22 LPA
Leumas is seeking a Process Equipment Designer to drive the design and development of next generation process equipment and modular manufacturing systems.
This is a high-ownership engineering role responsible for translating process requirements into robust mechanical designs and executing across the complete build lifecycle—concept → design → prototype → fabrication → commissioning → iteration. The role requires strong mechanical fundamentals, disciplined design practices, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, build-first environment alongside process, controls, and software teams.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-definedproduction platform for healthcare manufacturing. Its proprietary, full-stack Manufacturing Operating System orchestrates the entire manufacturing lifecycle - from formulation logic and material flow to production execution, quality control, and traceability - enabling modular, reconfigurable factories that scale with demand.
Leumas addresses structural challenges in global supply chains, rigidity, long lead times, and capital intensive, step function scale - through a modular, distributed manufacturing architecture that enables faster deployment, higher asset utilization, and materially improved business outcomes across product
life cycle.
Leumas supports two primary deployment models. For enterprise customers, it enables dedicated manufacturing suites that provide high levels of supply-chain control, compliance, and flexibility without the burden of traditional greenfield capex or non-resilient supply chains from traditional CDMOs. For healthcare innovators, the platform allows rapid configuration of production lines through software, enabling faster product launches, tighter quality control, and responsive scale-up or scale
down.
Leumas’ production systems currently support more than a dozen finished formulations and consumer health formats, including semi-solids (ointments, gels, lotions), oral solid dosage forms (tablets, capsules), and liquid formulations, with integrated QA and inspection capabilities.

The Role
As Process Equipment Designer, you will contribute to the mechanical design and delivery of process equipment platforms that enable modular, automated manufacturing.
You will work across system architecture, detailed design, prototyping, fabrication support, and commissioning stabilization. You will be expected to apply DFMA rigor, maintain high-quality documentation, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, production
ready equipment.

What You Will Own
As Process Equipment Designer, you will be responsible for designing equipment that meets defined technical, operational, and manufacturability requirements while enabling rapid iteration and deployment.
1. Process Equipment Design & System Architecture
→ Translate process requirements into equipment concepts, architectures, and detailed mechanical designs.
→ Define interfaces, constraints, tolerances, and integration boundaries across modules.
→ Drive design decisions that balance performance, reliability, serviceability, and manufacturability.
2. End-to-End Build Cycle Execution
→ Participate across the full lifecycle: concept → design → prototype → fabrication → commissioning → iteration.
→ Support fabrication and assembly with engineering clarity, build-time issue resolution, and rapid design iterations.
→ Contribute to commissioning stabilization and continuous improvement loops.
3. Design for Manufacturing & Assembly (DFMA)
→ Apply DFMA principles to improve manufacturability, reduce complexity, and increase repeatability.
→ Standardize components, sub-assemblies, and fabrication approaches where appropriate.
→ Contribute to value engineering initiatives for cost, throughput, and maintainability improvements.
4. CAD, Drawings & Documentation Control
→ Create and maintain CAD models, drawings, and BOMs using SolidWorks / Fusion 360 (or equivalent).
→ Maintain structured documentation practices including revision control and design traceability.
→ Support design reviews through clear engineering rationale and documentation readiness.
5. Cross-Functional Integration
→ Work closely with Process, Controls, Software, Quality, and Production functions to deliver integrated systems.
→ Participate in structured reviews and resolve multidisciplinary integration issues during build and commissioning.
→ Ensure mechanical designs are aligned to operational execution and long-term scalability needs.
","You’re a Fit If
1. You are a post-graduate (M.Tech / MS / PhD) in Mechanical, Design, Manufacturing, or allied engineering disciplines.
2. You have hands-on exposure to process equipment design / NPD / prototyping through thesis work, internships, or industry roles.
3. You have strong fundamentals in mechanical design, system architecture, and DFMA.
4. You are proficient with CAD tools (SolidWorks / Fusion 360 or equivalent).
5. You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, build-first engineering environment (not research only).
6. You demonstrate strong ownership, execution discipline, and cross-functional collaboration capability.

How You Will Operate
1. You execute with high ownership, accountability, and engineering rigor.
2. You maintain structured workflows and clear documentation standards.
3. You balance iteration speed with design quality, validation, and build readiness.
4. You communicate with clarity and precision across technical and operational teams.
5. You continuously improve designs based on fabrication and commissioning feedback.

Why Join
1. You will contribute directly to core platform equipment and next-generation manufacturing systems.
2. You will work across the complete lifecycle from concept to commissioning, building real systems, not prototypes in isolation.
3. You will operate in a high-growth, execution-driven environment with strong cross-functional exposure.
4. Your work will directly influence scalability, reliability, and platform IP creation.

Role Details
Eligibility: Post-graduates only (M.Tech / MS / PhD)
Location: Bengaluru (On-site)

Embedded Intelligence, Edge AI & Cyber-Physical Systems
Leumas · Bengaluru
Leumas is seeking an AI & Firmware Engineer in Residence to design, develop, and deploy intelligent control and monitoring systems for autonomous manufacturing platforms. This role sits at the intersection of embedded firmware, edge intelligence, and system integration. The position is responsible for translating AI/ML models into reliable, real-time, production-grade behaviour on constrained hardware, while maintaining engineering rigor and operational stability.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-defined production platform for healthcare manufacturing. Its proprietary, full-stack Manufacturing Operating System orchestrates the entire manufacturing lifecycle - from formulation logic and material flow to production execution, quality control, and traceability - enabling modular, reconfigurable factories that scale with demand.
Leumas addresses structural challenges in global supply chains, rigidity, long lead times, and capital intensive, step function scale - through a modular, distributed manufacturing architecture that enables faster deployment, higher asset utilization, and materially improved business outcomes across product life cycle Leumas supports two primary deployment models. For enterprise customers, it enables dedicated manufacturing suites that provide high levels of supply-chain control, compliance, and flexibility without the burden of traditional greenfield capex or non-resilient supply chains from traditional CDMOs. For healthcare innovators, the platform allows rapid configuration of production lines through software, enabling faster product launches, tighter quality control, and responsive scale-up or scale down.
Leumas’ production systems currently support more than a dozen finished formulations and consumer health formats, including semi-solids (ointments, gels, lotions), oral solid dosage forms (tablets, capsules), and liquid formulations, with integrated QA and inspection capabilities.

The Role
As AI & Firmware Engineer in Residence, you will own the embedded firmware foundation and edge intelligence layer of Leumas’ manufacturing systems.
You will be responsible for building real-time firmware, integrating AI/ML models with physical systems, and ensuring reliable closed-loop operation across sensing, control, and optimization workflows.
This role requires strong technical depth, hands-on execution capability, and the ability to operate across firmware, data, and systems integration layers.

What You Will Own
As AI & Firmware Engineer in Residence, you will be accountable for the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of intelligent embedded systems.
1. Embedded Firmware Development
• Design and develop firmware using C/C++, RTOS, and microcontroller platforms.
• Implement device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, and system services.
• Ensure real-time performance, stability, and fault tolerance.
2. Edge AI & Model Integration
• Integrate AI/ML models into embedded and edge devices.
• Optimize models for constrained hardware environments.
• Implement monitoring, fallback, and fail-safe mechanisms.
3. Sensor Data & Real-Time Processing Pipelines
• Design and maintain sensor data pipelines for real-time acquisition and processing.
• Enable deterministic communication between sensing, inference, and control layers.
• Support closed-loop system validation and tuning.
4. AI-Driven Control & Optimization Systems
• Develop AI-based control, vision, anomaly detection, and optimization modules.
• Deploy intelligent monitoring and diagnostic frameworks.
• Support commissioning and stabilization of autonomous functions.
5. System Integration & Engineering Governance
• Work across firmware, edge intelligence, and system integration layers.
• Maintain structured documentation, validation records, and release packages.
• Participate in design, safety, and technical reviews.

The Responsible Investing (RI) team sits within the Impact Group and plays a crucial role in reinforcing BII’s reputation as a responsible investor, ensuring it meets its regulatory commitments and enhancing private sector standards on financial crime risk management, corporate governance and environmental and social standards. The team has ownership of shaping and operationalising BII’s Policy for Responsible Investment (PRI), ensuring it is fit for purpose in BII’s investment activities.

The team comprising professionals based in the UK, India, Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa is involved in all BII investments and plays a critical role in ensuring that BII’s PRI is consistently applied across all transactions. As well as managing the assessment of investments in pipeline, the team is also responsible for portfolio management of investees, working on improved performance of responsible investing standards, capacity building, issues management and market shaping initiatives that support improved standards more widely and help build value across BII’s portfolio

An analyst in BII’s RI Sector team will have a direct reporting line to a Manager within RI.

Purpose
The RI Sector teams is structured into three sector teams aligning to our investment pillars: Financial Services (FSG), Infrastructure & Climate (I&C), and Industries, Technology & Services (ITS). The RI Sector teams support a wide range of transactions from the earliest stage of origination through pipeline development, due diligence, approval and portfolio monitoring.

An Analyst in an RI sector team will work on the Responsible Investing workstream for both pipeline and portfolio stage transactions. This will include supporting the operationalising of the PRI requirements and fostering a positive team culture.

An Analyst will have the ability to develop a consistent track record for risk management on the responsible investing disciplines of environmental and social (E&S), and with a desire to build experience across disciplines and develop as many transferable skills over time as possible.

Key Responsibilities
Transactional Work
• Support and contribute to completion of relevant E&S risk assessment and due diligence, at early-stages of transaction appraisal.
• Support RI team in conducting site visits and implementation of PRI with investees E&S personnel at investees assets
• Shadow and support on transactions in pipeline and portfolio
• Develop sound judgement and procedural adherence in escalating material risks or incidents, either to your line manager, sector vertical head or other internal functions, as relevant.
 Process Integration & Portfolio Oversight
• Support to ensure consistent application of BII’s E&S requirements and policies across BII’s investees.
• Timely escalation of material RI risks/concerns identified in the course of portfolio monitoring to subject matter experts, Directors or Team Heads as appropriate, working with these colleagues to analyse and remediate.
• Support with data extraction and data-based analytics and insights as required for portfolio management, risk trend analysis and internal and external RI reporting.

Stakeholder Engagement
• Support the development and roll-out of strategically important initiatives, ensuring commercially relevant and precedent-setting positions are well articulated.

Training & Knowledge Sharing
• Shadow the delivery of RI training for internal teams and external investees.
• Support the development of briefing materials, case studies and other materials that showcase how E&S business practices contribute to commercial and impact success.

Develop broader cross disciplinary RI understanding
• Develop cross disciplinary RI competencies via learning by doing, formal and informal internal and external training and proactive engagement with others in RI team.
• Foster a strong team culture and act as a culture carrier for RI team.

Regional Element
• Local expertise: develop knowledge of local regulations, trends, listing requirements, industry associations, sustainability/compliance headwinds and market intelligence and regularly share with the RI team.
• Strategy and pipeline: shadow and support the integration of RI inputs into regional strategies and investment pipeline. This could include identifying potential risks/concerns related to the implementation of BII’s Policy on Responsible Investing and Fossil Fuel Policy and making timely escalations to Directors or Team Heads to ensure efficient origination activities. On occasion, meeting with prospective investees to introduce BII’s RI requirements and value creation approach.
• Relationship management: actively manage relationships with local internal stakeholders and investment team members.

Background, skills, aptitude
• Educated up to BSc degree (any degree discipline, environmental management, social sciences, economics, development studies, engineering or finance is advantageous)
• Passion and interest in environmental and social (E&S) with a desire to learn, grow and develop in the field.
• Ability to independently manage and prioritise a busy and diverse workload with a range of deliverables for a variety of stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, including report writing, use of PowerPoint and diagrams to present information in a concise format.
• Able to think critically and consider priorities and proportionality when proposing approaches or solutions
• Enjoy working as part of a team, collaborating and coordinating where appropriate.
• Flexible and agile work style, with the ability to work on multiple workstreams/topic areas as required
• Strong team player who enjoys working as part of a close team and is willing to collaborate and support the team on a variety of different initiatives and tasks
• Demonstrable alignment with BII’s mandate, mission, and values

Our cultural values
We look for team members who aspire, as we do, to work at our best and to be:
• Impact-led, commercially rigorous
• Tenacious in the face of challenges
• Collaborative and caring

British International Investment is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes all applicants regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or educational background.

British International Investment (BII) is the UK’s leading development finance institution, wholly owned by the UK Government. Our primary mission is to address global development challenges through strategic investments that promote sustainable and inclusive economic growth.

BII focuses on catalysing economic development, creating jobs, and building resilient economies in some of the world's most complex and underserved markets. We invest in businesses and projects that prioritise inclusive development, environmental sustainability, and innovation.

Our approach is characterised by rigorous investment standards, high governance principles, and a commitment to delivering measurable development impact. Our team consists of highly skilled and passionate professionals dedicated to making a tangible difference globally.

We foster a collaborative and intellectually stimulating work environment that values curiosity, innovation, and professional growth. conferences/journals.

efficient production solutions.

excellence, and continuous learning.
• Stay updated of the latest developments in AI and contribute to the strategic direction of
the research roadmap

preferred.

MPI, vectorization through SIMD/SIMT.
• Familiarity with C++, Python and Latex is assumed.
• Contributions to open-source AI libraries or toolkits.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills

• Computer architecture and parallel computing.
• Various AI models such as diffusion models, Gen-AI, LLMs, multi-modal AI, State-Space
models, etc.
• Various automation techniques such as control algorithms, reinforcement learning, etc.
• Various data compression algorithms.
• Privacy-preserving confidential computation, and/or Homomorphic Encryption.
• Global and/or stochastic mathematical analysis through foundational concepts
including, but not limited to, stochastic calculus, dynamical systems, and differential
geometry

Shell Lubricants Supply Chain (LSC) EMEA organisation covers more than 115 countries across Europe, Middle East and Africa. We provide ~1 Billion liters of lubricant per year to customers ranging from the world’s largest car manufacturers to small independent workshops, national utility companies to wind farms across the B2C and B2B customer groups.
The Supply Chain Optimisation & Development team, of which the Digital & Automation team is a part of, is accountable for all capital expenditure (~$80M per year) across EMEA. Within LSC, this team invests in the future of our assets, which consists of a network of 9 lubricants and grease manufacturing locations, to become modern, flexible, and adaptable to future customer needs.
The Automation Analyst is a member of the Digital & Automation team. The team is accountable for identifying, defining and implementing structural end to end digital and automation opportunities that create value for Shell. Driven by a dynamic landscape, automation, robotics, and data play pivotal roles for LSC EMEA.
The role reports into the Digital & Automation Manager. ROLE DESCRIPTION
Are you a data science enthusiast with a knack for supply chain optimisation, statistical analysis, and artificial intelligence? If so, keep reading!
As an Automation Analyst, you’ll be analysing and optimising our supply chain processes within LSC EMEA. You will be provided the opportunity to make a significant impact on our operations. This role involves working with data, modeling material flows, and optimization towards the most fit-for-purpose solutions. You’ll be using simulation software to identify the most optimal capital expenditure (CAPEX) investments, which will help to improve our supply chain competitiveness. For example, we’re significantly investing in automated mobile robots (AMR) across our sites. Typical questions the team addresses are;
· What are the best possible routes for the AMRs to navigate around our sites?
and
· How many AMRs do we need to avoid bottlenecks or risk congestion? And what should be the speed of our warehouses to match AMR capacity?
By applying your modeling expertise you will be supporting the team to get the right answers.
But there’s more! Over the years a lot of effort has gone into consistently collecting data-points across our supply chain, all integrated into one data platform. Though there’s more to do we see immense opportunities that are waiting to be explored. As an Automation Analyst you will be looking at opportunities to streamline and automate operations and processes. To do so you will be developing and deploying models in Python or Spark, depending on the size of the data. You’d be pivotal in bringing data closer to our decision-makers, enabling them to make informed decisions quickly. For example, by developing conversational AI interfaces that allow to query the data in natural language, making insights easily accessible and understandable for anyone.
All in all, as an Automation Analyst, you’ll be building and deploying your own models, as well as applying your modelling expertise to further advance our automation efforts across various parts of our supply chain!

YOU WILL BE EXPECTED TO
Analyse data:
· Conduct in-depth analyses of existing processes to identify potential areas for automation
· Run simulations to help design the ideal automation lay-out of our sites
· Model & simulate to identify the optimal CAPEX investments in LSC EMEA
· Recommend the best automation investment based on cost-benefit analysis
Develop and deploy models:
· Develop and deploy models using programming languages such as Python or Spark
· Deploy models into production environments and monitor their performance
Collaborate with cross-functional teams:
· Engage with various teams to identify automation opportunities
· Facilitate meetings with teams to discuss progress and address challenges
REQUIREMENTS
Excellent analytical & problem-solving skills
· Background in Applied Mathematics/Physics, Econometrics, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Technology, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Systems & Control, Transport, Infrastructure and Logistics
· Proven experience in supply chain analysis and modelling (preferred)
· Proficiency in data modeling and simulation tools
· Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Spark
Opportunity & project delivery in a supply chain environment
· Ability to analyse and translate complex opportunities into clear value propositions
· Ability to recognize links between opportunities/projects with the skill to develop overviews
· High personal drive and delivery focus; result oriented
Strong stakeholder management skills
· Interpersonal and influencing skills
· Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders
· Open minded, challenging others and own assumptions and output.
And most importantly, enthusiasm for innovation and technology adoption in manufacturing processes! If you do not possess all skills listed above don’t be put off, we invite you to explain us how you plan to leverage your skills to achieve our goals.

DESIRABLE SKILLS TO POSSESS OR DEVELOP
Commercial Acumen
· Commercial mindset to improve efficiency and competitiveness
· External focus, innovation, agility and speed
Mindset & Behaviors
· Foster a culture of curiosity to inspire others to think outside the box
· Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-past environment

Leumas is seeking a Business Analyst to drive structured market research, industry intelligence, and data-driven insights to support business strategy and account growth.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-defined production platform for regulated healthcare manufacturing. Its integrated Manufacturing Operating System enables modular, scalable, and compliant production across nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, and wellness products.
Leumas partners with brands across early-stage, growth-stage, and enterprise segments, delivering end-to-end product development and manufacturing solutions.

The Role
As Business Analyst, you will be responsible for building a comprehensive understanding of markets, customer segments, product trends, and competitive landscapes relevant to Leumas’ business.
You will work closely with Business Development, NPD, and leadership teams to provide structured research outputs and strategic insights, enabling more informed decision-making across client engagements and growth initiatives.
The role requires a methodical approach to research, strong attention to detail, and the ability to synthesize insights into actionable recommendations.

• Conduct in-depth research across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and wellness markets.

• Conduct structured primary research through stakeholder interactions, data gathering, and industry inputs.
• Collect, validate, and organize qualitative and quantitative data from multiple sources.
• Ensure reliability, relevance, and accuracy of research inputs.
4. Insight Generation & Strategic Recommendations
• Synthesize research findings into clear, structured insights and business implications.
• Develop reports, briefs, and presentations to support strategic discussions.
• Provide actionable recommendations for market entry, product positioning, and account growth.
5. Account Intelligence & Business Support
• Build detailed intelligence on client accounts, including product portfolios, target markets, and competitive positioning.
• Support Business Development and Account Management teams with research-backed inputs.
• Enable more informed client engagement, cross-sell, and upsell strategies.

Client-Facing Product Development & Tech-Commercial Execution
Leumas · Bengaluru
Leumas is seeking an NPD (New Product Development) Scientist to lead client-facing product development engagements and drive technical-commercial alignment across nutraceutical and healthcare manufacturing programs.
This role is responsible for interfacing directly with clients to understand, structure, and translate product requirements into executable development plans, while ensuring alignment with manufacturing feasibility, regulatory considerations, and commercial objectives. The position requires a strong ability to operate at the intersection of customer engagement, scientific understanding, and execution discipline.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-defined production platform for healthcare manufacturing. Its proprietary, full-stack Manufacturing Operating System orchestrates the entire manufacturing lifecycle - from formulation logic and material flow to production execution, quality control, and traceability - enabling modular, reconfigurable factories that scale with demand.
Leumas addresses structural challenges in global supply chains, rigidity, long lead times, and capital intensive, step function scale - through a modular, distributed manufacturing architecture that enables faster deployment, higher asset utilization, and materially improved business outcomes across product life cycle Leumas supports two primary deployment models. For enterprise customers, it enables dedicated manufacturing suites that provide high levels of supply chain control, compliance, and flexibility without the burden of traditional greenfield capex or non-resilient supply chains from traditional CDMOs.
For healthcare innovators, the platform allows rapid configuration of production lines through software, enabling faster product launches, tighter quality control, and responsive scale-up or scale down.
Leumas’ production systems currently support more than a dozen finished formulations and consumer health formats, including semi-solids (ointments, gels, lotions), oral solid dosage forms (tablets, capsules), and liquid formulations, with integrated QA and inspection capabilities.

The Role
As NPD Scientist, you will serve as the primary technical interface for clients during the product development lifecycle, owning the clarity, completeness, and alignment of all customer inputs.
You will work closely with Business Development, R&D, and Operations teams to ensure that client expectations are accurately interpreted, technically validated, and translated into structured execution plans.
The role requires a high degree of ownership in managing client interactions, aligning cross-functional teams, and ensuring that product development outcomes are consistent with both customer intent and operational realities.

What You Will Own
1. Client-Facing Technical Engagement (Primary Ownership)
• Lead structured technical discussions with clients to understand product intent, target outcomes, and positioning.
• Capture detailed inputs across formulation expectations, dosage formats, ingredient preferences, claims, packaging, and scale requirements.
• Identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks in client inputs, and proactively drive clarity.
• Act as the single point of technical ownership during client interactions in the development phase.
• Manage client expectations with respect to feasibility, timelines, and development scope.
2. Requirement Structuring & Internal Translation
• Translate client discussions into comprehensive and structured technical briefs for internal teams.
• Define clear scope, assumptions, constraints, and execution parameters.
• Ensure alignment of all stakeholders on product requirements before initiation of development.
• Maintain consistency between client communication and internal execution plans.
3. Commercial & Feasibility Alignment
• Work closely with Business Development teams to align customer requirements with cost structures, timelines, and operational constraints.
• Provide technical inputs for pricing, feasibility assessments, and proposal development.
• Support client discussions involving trade-offs between cost, performance, and manufacturability.
• Ensure commitments made to clients are realistic and executable.
4. Client Communication & Relationship Management
• Act as a key technical stakeholder in client calls, presentations, and follow-ups.
• Communicate progress, challenges, and changes in a clear and professional manner.
• Build credibility and trust with clients through structured and informed engagement.
• Support onboarding of clients from discussion stage into execution readiness.
5. Product Development & Formulation Support
• Support formulation development across dosage forms such as capsules, tablets, powders, and blends.
• Guide selection of actives, excipients, and delivery mechanisms based on defined requirements.
• Assist in trials, optimization, and scale-up activities as required.
6. Documentation & Execution Readiness
• Maintain structured records of client requirements, discussions, and decisions.
• Ensure traceability between client inputs, formulation outputs, and execution plans.
• Support preparation of technical documentation, dossiers, and validation records.
• Enable audit-ready documentation across development stages.

Location: Bangalore
Role Type: Full-time / Research Engineer
________________________________________
Role Overview
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer with strong exposure to mechatronic systems and real-world environmental constraints. The role involves designing robust mechanical systems that integrate electronics and RF components, with a focus on thermal management, EMI/EMC considerations, and field deployment reliability.
This role is well suited for candidates who enjoy working at the intersection of mechanical, electrical, and system engineering, translating complex requirements into practical hardware.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Mechanical System Design
• Design and develop mechanical enclosures and assemblies for integrated electronic systems
• Work on ruggedization for real-world environments (temperature, vibration, dust, moisture)
• Optimize for size, weight, and structural integrity
• Select materials based on thermal, structural, and environmental requirements
________________________________________
Mechatronic Integration
• Integrate electronics, RF modules, antennas, and power systems into compact mechanical designs
• Collaborate with electrical and RF teams for layout, grounding, and shielding strategies
• Design for cabling, connectors, and serviceability
• Ensure mechanical designs support system-level performance
________________________________________
Thermal Design & Analysis
• Perform thermal analysis and heat dissipation design
• Design passive and active cooling solutions (heat sinks, airflow, conduction paths)
• Evaluate system performance across wide temperature ranges
• Use tools such as ANSYS / SolidWorks Simulation / equivalent
________________________________________
EMI/EMC & Environmental Considerations
• Design enclosures with EMI/EMC shielding and grounding considerations
• Work with RF teams to minimize interference and coupling issues
• Ensure compliance with environmental and electromagnetic constraints
• Implement sealing and protection strategies (IP-rated designs where required)
________________________________________
Prototyping & Testing
• Develop rapid prototypes using machining / 3D printing
• Conduct fitment, structural, and environmental testing
• Iterate designs based on test results and field feedback
________________________________________
Required Skills & Background
• Strong fundamentals in:
o Mechanical design and engineering principles
o Material selection and structural analysis
• Experience with CAD tools:
o SolidWorks / Fusion 360 / CATIA / equivalent
• Understanding of:
o Thermal management in electronic systems
o EMI/EMC basics and shielding concepts
• Exposure to mechatronic system design and integration
________________________________________
Preferred (Not Mandatory)
• Experience with:
o Ruggedized or field-deployable systems
o Electronics packaging and enclosure design
• Familiarity with:
o IP ratings, environmental standards, and testing protocols
• Hands-on experience with:
o Prototyping tools, machining, or fabrication workflows
________________________________________
What We Value
• Strong systems thinking across mechanical + electrical domains
• Ability to translate complex constraints into clean design solutions
• Bias toward practical, buildable designs
• Ownership and ability to iterate quickly in a product-driven environment
________________________________________
Ideal Candidate Profile
• MTech / BTech / PhD / final-year students in:
o Mechanical Engineering / Mechatronics / Product Design
• Or candidates with equivalent hands-on experience in system-level mechanical design
________________________________________
What You’ll Work On
• Mechanical systems for advanced electronic platforms
• Design challenges involving:
o Thermal management
o EMI/EMC-aware enclosures
o Compact and rugged system integration
• End-to-end development from concept to field validation
________________________________________
Outcome Expectations (Initial Phase)
• Deliver validated mechanical designs and prototypes
• Enable robust integration of electronics and RF subsystems
• Establish thermal and environmental validation workflows
________________________________________
This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging, multidisciplinary systems where mechanical design directly impacts system performance and reliability.

Location: Bangalore
Role Type: Full-time / Research Engineer
________________________________________
Role Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated Antenna Design Engineer to work on advanced RF systems involving wideband sensing, direction finding, and communication applications.
This role is ideal for candidates with strong fundamentals in electromagnetics and RF systems, who enjoy translating theory into practical, deployable hardware.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Antenna Design & Development
• Design and develop wideband and multi-band antennas across sub-GHz to multi-GHz frequencies
• Explore novel antenna architectures for compact and high-performance applications
• Optimize gain, efficiency, bandwidth, and radiation characteristics
• Design for real-world constraints such as size, environment, and integration
________________________________________
Array Design & Spatial Processing
• Develop antenna arrays for direction finding (DF), beamforming, and spatial sensing
• Work on array geometries such as linear, circular, and stacked configurations
• Analyze phase coherence, mutual coupling, and calibration strategies
• Collaborate with signal processing teams for end-to-end system performance
________________________________________
Simulation & Electromagnetic Modeling
• Perform EM simulations using tools such as:
o CST Microwave Studio / HFSS / FEKO / equivalent
• Conduct parametric studies and optimization
• Model effects of ground planes, enclosures, and real-world environments
________________________________________
Measurement & Validation
• Conduct antenna testing including:
o VSWR / S11, radiation pattern, gain, efficiency
• Work with lab equipment such as:
o Vector Network Analyzer (VNA), spectrum analyzer
• Participate in field testing and validation
• Develop calibration and characterization methodologies
________________________________________
Prototyping & Iteration
• Build and test rapid prototypes
• Work with fabrication teams on PCB antennas and RF assemblies
• Iterate designs based on measurement feedback and system needs
________________________________________
Required Skills & Background
• Strong foundation in:
o Electromagnetics and antenna theory
o RF fundamentals and propagation
• Familiarity with antenna simulation tools (CST / HFSS / FEKO or similar)
• Understanding of:
o Impedance matching and RF design basics
o Radiation patterns, polarization, and bandwidth concepts
• Exposure to RF lab measurements or simulations
________________________________________
Preferred (Not Mandatory)
• Experience or coursework in:
o Antenna arrays / beamforming / direction finding
o Wideband or multi-band antenna design
• Familiarity with:
o SDR-based systems or RF signal processing
o Python / MATLAB for analysis and modeling
• Hands-on experience with:
o VNA or RF measurement setups
________________________________________
What We Value
• Strong first-principles thinking
• Ability to move from theory → simulation → prototype
• Curiosity to explore new antenna and RF architectures
• Bias toward practical, field-deployable solutions
________________________________________
Ideal Candidate Profile
• MTech / PhD / final-year students in:
o Electrical Engineering / RF & Microwave / Applied Electromagnetics
• Or candidates with equivalent hands-on experience in RF/antenna systems
________________________________________
What You’ll Work On
• Real-world RF systems involving:
o Wideband sensing
o Spatial signal analysis
o Robust communication links
• End-to-end development from concept to field validation
________________________________________
Outcome Expectations (Initial Phase)
• Develop and validate antenna prototypes
• Contribute to array design and system integration
• Establish measurement and testing workflows
________________________________________
This role offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced electromagnetics, RF systems, and real-world deployment challenges, with significant scope for innovation and impact.

About the Role:
Alstom invites applications for a PhD Intern position in our Student Researcher Program, focusing on Formal Methods for verifying safety-critical systems. This role presents a unique opportunity to collaborate with Alstom’s research scientists and engineers in addressing challenges related to model checking and theorem proving.
Objectives:
· Model Checking: Develop and implement model checking algorithms to verify the correctness of safety-critical system designs against specified requirements.
· Theorem Proving: Utilize theorem proving techniques to establish the formal correctness of system properties, ensuring adherence to safety and operational standards.
· Formal Verification Framework: Contribute to the creation and enhancement of frameworks that integrate formal verification methods with existing development processes, improving the overall quality and reliability of our systems.
Problem Statement:
Ensuring the safety and reliability of critical systems is paramount in our projects. The current approaches to verification can be inefficient and may not capture all scenarios, leading to potential safety risks. By advancing the use of formal methods, we aim to enhance our verification processes and ensure our systems meet the highest safety standards.

· Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
· Knowledge and working experience in model checking and theorem proving concepts.
· Familiarity with formal verification tools and techniques.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Participation in this program requires that you are in India for the duration of the engagement.
· This opportunity is best suited for students who do not seek full-time employment following this role, as this program is non-conversion eligible.
· Please list your anticipated graduation date (in MM/YY) and any relevant technical skills on your resume.
About Alstom:
Alstom is a leader in the mobility sector, tackling the most challenging problems for the future of transportation. Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
Company: Truveta
About Truveta
Truveta is transforming healthcare by enabling researchers, clinicians, and life sciences organizations to learn from one of the most comprehensive collections of de-identified patient data in the United States. With access to longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data from over 120 million patients (which represents over a third of the US population), we are uniquely positioned to drive breakthroughs in clinical research and improve patient outcomes.
The Role
We are seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to explore and develop novel applications of cutting-edge AI/ML technologies on large-scale real-world clinical data.
This role is designed for recent PhD graduates who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of machine learning in healthcare. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, clinical data, and biomedical science, identifying new opportunities where modern AI can unlock insights that were previously out of reach.
A key expectation is not just execution—but imagination: the ability to envision and prototype entirely new ways to use rich patient data to solve meaningful healthcare problems.
What You’ll Do
• Innovate: Identify and propose novel, high-impact applications of AI/ML using large-scale EHR data
• Research & Prototype: Design, develop, and evaluate state-of-the-art models (e.g., foundation models, multimodal learning, causal ML, generative AI)
• Work Across Modalities: Integrate structured and unstructured EHR data with emerging data types such as genomics, imaging, and clinical notes

Fluxion operates in environments where mechanical failure costs crore of rupees per hour: port terminal equipment at Kandla,
steel plant material handling systems, automated guided vehicle fleets, and EV manufacturing assembly lines. The mechanical
engineer we are hiring will be working at the interface between these physical systems and the digital intelligence we are deploying
on top of them.
This is not a design office role. You will be on site. You will be assessing real plant, specifying real components, and working
alongside electronics and systems engineers to make automated systems function in the physical world. If your ideal engineering
career involves staying at a desk, this is not the right position.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Condition assessment of mechanical plant at port, steel, and manufacturing sites: conveyors, cranes, reach stackers, AGV
infrastructure, and material handling equipment
– Specification and procurement of components for automation retrofits: drive systems, structural modifications, and motion control
hardware
– Failure mode and effects analysis for rotating and lifting equipment, informing where sensors are placed and what predictive
maintenance models need to monitor
– Site oversight of mechanical works at demo installations and pilot deployments, coordinating with contractors and site teams
– Electromechanical integration work alongside electronics engineers: motor control, actuator selection, and load analysis for
automated systems
– Vendor assessment for AGV manufacturers, conveyor OEMs, and automation equipment suppliers
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in mechanical engineering from a recognised institution
– Sound grounding in core mechanical principles: stress analysis, machine design, dynamics, and thermal systems
– Comfort with engineering drawings, P&IDs, and equipment specifications — you should be able to read them, not just produce
them
– Any hands-on experience with industrial equipment, workshop practice, or real physical systems, whether through internship,
project, or personal interest
– Willingness to spend significant time on industrial sites across India; site work is a large part of this role
– Exposure to automation, robotics, or mechatronics through coursework or projects is a meaningful advantage
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.

1.About the company. Vision and Mission
Agile Energy X Inc. was established in 2022 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tokyo Electric Power Grid Co., Inc. The company provides innovative solutions that leverage unused renewable energy, such as "distributed computing," to optimize power grids by flexibly creating electricity demand.
Its primary business activities include the development and operation of power-demand facilities, such as container-based Bitcoin mining systems powered by renewable energy. These efforts generate various added values, including environmental and digital benefits, contributing to the promotion of renewable energy adoption. Furthermore, the company is committed to revitalizing local economies and promoting local energy production for local consumption.

Unlike traditional programs with predefined tasks, this program encourages each participant to bring their own ideas and skills to address issues in the energy sector.
Additionally, this program offers a rare opportunity to learn under the guidance of our exceptional CEO, who holds an MBA from Stanford University.

Specifically, interns will work on projects aimed at the flexible utilization of renewable energy and the optimization of distributed energy resources (DER). Through group work, students will explore solutions to these issues and integrate them into real-world projects.
A key feature of this program is its emphasis on leveraging technical curiosity and creativity to develop solutions that account for social impact. Participants will gain valuable experience in contributing to the development of future energy systems while exploring innovative ways to harness renewable energy.
We are looking for students who are genuinely interested in renewable energy and digital technologies, eager to learn proactively, and motivated to collaborate with a team to solve challenges. This internship offers an opportunity not only to deepen technical skills but also to engage in socially significant projects while building practical expertise.

THE ROLE
Every data stream that feeds Fluxion's AI systems begins with a sensor correctly specified, installed, and communicating reliably.
Every actuation command our models generate must be executed by a control system that is safe, deterministic, and auditable.
The electronics engineer owns this layer entirely.
We are deploying sensor networks at port terminals, instrumentation on steel plant equipment, and embedded control systems for
AGVs and automated handling machinery. You will be involved in hardware selection, embedded firmware oversight, and field
commissioning from early in your role. Industrial environments are electrically noisy, physically harsh, and unforgiving of
specification errors.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Sensor selection and specification: LiDAR, computer vision cameras, RFID readers, thermocouple and RTD arrays, vibration
sensors, and industrial communication modules
– Embedded systems design and firmware oversight for edge compute nodes, sensor hubs, and control interfaces on microcontroller
and SoC platforms
– Industrial communication protocols: Modbus, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, OPC-UA, and CANbus — learning to work with these in
real plant environments
– PCB review and hardware bring-up for custom sensor integration boards and signal conditioning circuits
– Field commissioning and calibration of instrumentation at port and industrial sites, including characterisation in high-noise
environments
– Hardware reliability analysis: MTBF estimation, environmental protection ratings, and maintenance intervals for deployed systems
– Coordination with software and systems engineers on data acquisition architecture and real-time pipeline interfaces
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in electronics, electrical, or instrumentation engineering from a recognised institution
– Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, or hardware prototyping — lab and project work counts, not just
theory
– Understanding of at least one industrial communication standard or signal conditioning approach at a practical level
– Familiarity with basic EMC principles and electrical safety considerations for industrial environments
– Any exposure to SCADA, PLC, or DCS systems through internship or coursework is a strong advantage
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.

THE ROLE
Fluxion's technology deployments are not standalone applications. They are distributed systems spanning edge compute nodes on
the plant floor, on-premise servers in control rooms, secure data links, and operator-facing dashboards used by people who have
no interest in the underlying architecture. The systems architecture engineer makes all of this work as a coherent, reliable whole.
This function sits between the domain-specific technology — sensors, AI models, control logic — and the operational reality of
an industrial plant: intermittent connectivity, legacy PLCs, IT security requirements from port trusts, and the need for every
system to degrade gracefully. Getting this right is harder than building the models it supports, and it is where most industrial AI
deployments fail.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– End-to-end architecture design for Fluxion's industrial AI platforms: data ingestion from field sensors through edge processing to
analytics and operator interfaces
– Edge compute design for latency-critical applications: real-time control advisory systems, breakout detection, and autonomous
vehicle coordination
– Integration work with legacy industrial systems: SCADA, DCS, historian databases, and PLC data extraction using OPC-UA,
MQTT, and protocol bridges
– Data pipeline architecture: schema design, buffering strategies, data quality monitoring, and backfill handling for connectivity gaps
– Security design for industrial control environments: network segmentation, access control, and audit logging
– System reliability design: redundancy, failover behaviour, monitoring and alerting, and recovery procedures for production-critical
deployments
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, or a related technical discipline from a
recognised institution
– Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, networking, and operating systems — you understand what happens below the
application layer
– Any prior exposure to industrial systems, embedded platforms, or operational technology through internship, research, or personal
projects
– Comfort producing technical documentation and explaining system design decisions clearly
– Exposure to containerisation, time-series data systems, or ICS security is a meaningful advantage

offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.

THE ROLE
Fluxion's data science function is operational, not academic. The models we build run in production environments where their
outputs influence decisions worth crore of rupees: sinter plant coke dosing, blast furnace thermal management, port berth
utilisation, and clinical patient flow. A model that achieves high accuracy on a held-out dataset but drifts silently in production, or
produces outputs no operator can interpret, is not useful.
We are looking for someone from an engineering, mathematics, or computer science background who builds analytical systems
with the same rigour they would apply to a physical design. You will work on real plant data from deployment day one. The
problems are not textbook problems: the data is noisy, the labels are delayed or absent, and the failure consequences are visible
immediately.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Development and validation of predictive models for industrial processes: equipment health monitoring, process parameter
optimisation, throughput forecasting, and anomaly detection
– Feature engineering from plant sensor data: time-series preprocessing, rolling statistics, frequency-domain features, and
physics-informed derived variables
– Model deployment pipelines: packaging models for edge inference, building monitoring frameworks for production model
performance
– Automated reporting and visualisation: operational dashboards for plant managers, investor-facing analytics outputs, and internal
performance tracking
– Statistical analysis in support of commercial decisions: cost-benefit modelling for automation investments and PFI index
calculations
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in engineering, mathematics, statistics, or computer science from a recognised institution
– Analytical-grade programming: you have built data pipelines or analytical systems beyond tutorial exercises
– Sound statistical foundations: you understand the difference between a model that fits and one that generalises, and you know
when a simpler approach is right
– Any project, thesis, or internship work involving real data and a problem with genuine uncertainty
– Ability to communicate quantitative results to non-technical stakeholders, both in writing and visual formats
– Exposure to time-series data, signal processing, or sensor data systems is a meaningful advantage
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.

Location: Hyderabad / Remote-Capable Type: Permanent · Full-Time
Compensation: FP1 to FP3 · ₹16 LPA to ₹45 LPA
CTC
Contact: Placement Cell
THE ROLE
Fluxion's AI engineering function is the most technically demanding layer of our stack. We are working on physics-informed
neural networks for industrial process prediction, graph neural networks for multi-modal logistics optimisation, computer vision
systems for autonomous port cargo handling, and clinical NLP for hospital operations.
We engage international research partners from Berkeley and specialist robotics institutes. The AI engineer we hire from campus
will be the internal technical function that works alongside these partners, builds production implementations of their research
outputs, and takes responsibility for what runs in live deployments.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Implementation and adaptation of physics-informed ML models for industrial process prediction: sinter bed combustion, blast
furnace thermal state, and rolling mill pass optimisation
– Graph neural network work for supply chain and logistics: modelling multi-node cargo flows as structured graph problems
– Computer vision pipeline development for port automation: object detection, container tracking, autonomous vehicle perception,
and OCR for container identification
– Clinical AI development for ETOH: NLP for patient record processing and outcome prediction models
– Model productionisation: converting research-grade implementations into efficient, monitorable inference systems for edge or
on-premise deployment
– Technical engagement with external research partners: understanding their deliverables, reviewing implementations, and identifying
what needs to change for production
– MLOps infrastructure: experiment tracking, model versioning, performance monitoring, and retraining pipelines
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in computer science, mathematics, or engineering with strong ML fundamentals from a recognised
institution
– Genuine depth in at least one ML area beyond standard supervised learning: you have gone past tutorials and built something
non-trivial
– Any prior project or research experience involving physics-informed ML, graph networks, computer vision, or NLP at a non-trivial
level
– Understanding that industrial AI is different from consumer AI: latency, interpretability, safety, and the cost of silent failure in a
physical system
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.

The Technical Program Manager operates within the Founder’s Office, embedded directly into the engineering organization.
