The School of Management Sciences at Chanakya University is seeking applications for faculty positions in the areas of Human Resources Management, Organizational Behaviour, Marketing, Strategy, Finance & Accounting. The role of an Assistant Professor is to engage in teaching, research, and other academic activities to contribute to the university's academic excellence and knowledge dissemination. They are responsible for nurturing students' learning, conducting research in their area of expertise, and actively participating in university service and development activities.

Responsibilities

Teaching and Curriculum Development:
• Prepare and deliver lectures, tutorials, and practical sessions to undergraduate and/or postgraduate students.
• Designing and developing course curricula that align with the NEP framework, and the objectives of the department and university. 
• Employing innovative pedagogical methods to engage students actively in the learning process.
• Provide guidance and mentorship to students, encouraging their academic and professional growth.
Research and Scholarly Activities:
• Engaging in rigorous scholarly research and publication in relevant academic areas, demonstrating a commitment to contribute to the advancement of knowledge.
• Pursuing collaborative research projects, both within the department and with other faculty members and institutions, to promote interdisciplinary research and innovation. 
• Apply for research grants and funding to support research activities.
Academic Evaluation and Assessment:
• Assisting in curriculum development, assessment, and accreditation processes 
• Design and administer assessments, examinations, and assignments to evaluate students' learning outcomes.
• Provide timely and constructive feedback to students to help them improve their academic performance.
Institution Development Activities:
• Participate in departmental and university committees, contributing to academic governance and decision-making processes.
• Engage in community service and outreach activities to promote the university's social impact. 
Professional Development:
• Pursuing continuous professional development by attending conferences, workshops, and seminars in the relevant field of expertise.
• Staying updated with advancements in teaching methodologies, research trends. 
• Attend conferences, workshops, and seminars to network and share knowledge with peers.
Mentorship and Advising:
• Act as an academic advisor to students, providing guidance on course selection, career paths, and personal development.
• Supervise and mentor research scholars and students on academic projects.
Collaboration and Networking:
• Collaborate with colleagues within and outside the university to foster interdisciplinary research and academic initiatives.
• Engage in partnerships with industry, government, and other academic institutions for research and collaboration opportunities.

Qualifications Required:

• A PhD in relevant discipline from a recognised institute of repute. 
• 1-5 years of teaching and / or relevant industry experience will be an advantage

Skills Required:

• Dedication to maintaining high academic standards and promoting a positive learning environment.
• A passion for teaching, research, and academic pursuits.
• Commitment to upholding ethical practices in research and teaching, in particular in the context of AI driven research and teaching
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Familiarity with the National Education Policy framework will be beneficial.
• Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and students from diverse backgrounds.

Reporting Relationship

• Reports to the Dean of the School

AI engines are forming product shortlists before buyers ever visit a brand’s website. When someone asks ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity “what’s the best CRM for a 50-person sales team?” or “which vitamin C serum works for oily skin?” — the AI names two or three brands. Everyone else is invisible. There is no second page in an AI answer.
We now have a working product, paying clients, and a pipeline of qualified prospects from outbound and inbound. What we don’t have is a dedicated closer. Today, the founder runs every demo. That doesn’t scale. This role exists to own the revenue line — from qualified lead to signed contract — and eventually to build the sales function from the ground up.

WHAT THE SALE LOOKS LIKE
The buyer. VP Marketing, Head of E-commerce, Head of Growth, or founder at companies doing $10M–$100M+ in revenue. These are people who own acquisition budgets, feel organic traffic declining, and have started noticing that AI gives weird or incomplete answers about their brand. They’re on LinkedIn, they’re in industry Slacks, and most of them don’t yet know that “AI visibility” is a category.
The pipeline. You inherit a qualified pipeline from two sources: (1) cold outbound run by our GTM team via personalized email and LinkedIn sequences, and (2) warm inbound from content, AI Shelf Check teardowns, and audit-led marketing. You don’t need to build a list or write cold emails. You pick up where the SDR leaves off — and close.
The cycle. Typically 2–4 weeks for mid-market deals, longer for enterprise. Discovery call → audit walkthrough (you present the brand’s AI visibility scores with real data) → proposal → negotiation → close. The audit is the sales weapon — when a VP Marketing sees that their brand scores 28/100 on non-branded queries while their competitor scores 71, the conversation shifts from “why should I care?” to “what do we fix first?”
The deal. $10–30K annual contract value. Land-and-expand motion — most clients start with an audit and monitoring engagement, then expand into structured data, content fixes, and authority building. Your job is to land the first contract; expansion revenue follows from delivery quality.
The geography. US and India. US prospects are the larger pipeline — you’ll run demos in the evening IST (some 7 PM–12 AM calls, not every day) and manage asynchronous follow-ups. India meetings are in-person or daytime video calls. You need to be comfortable operating across both.

WHAT YOU OWN
The demo. You run every qualified demo from day 30 onward. Discovery, needs assessment, audit walkthrough, objection handling, next-step setting. You make the buyer see what they’re losing by being invisible to AI — with their own data, not a generic pitch.
The close. Proposal creation, pricing negotiation, contract execution. You own the full cycle from qualified opportunity to signed deal. No one else is closing for you.
The handoff. Clean handoff to the Solutions Engineer post-close. Client expectations set correctly. No overpromising to win the deal and then leaving delivery to clean up.
The feedback loop. You are the closest person to the buyer’s voice. What objections come up repeatedly? Which ICP segments convert fastest? What messaging makes people lean in vs tune out? You feed this back to the founder and the GTM team — and it shapes the playbook.
The CRM. Pipeline hygiene, deal stage accuracy, activity logging, forecast updates. If it’s not in the CRM, it didn’t happen.

YOUR FIRST 12 MONTHS
Month 1
Learn the product, the buyer, the pitch
Shadow the founder on live demos. Run the audit on 5 brands yourself so you can explain every score. Study closed-won and closed-lost deals. Understand why a VP Marketing in the US cares about AI visibility and what makes them say yes.
Months 2–3
Run demos, close your first deals
Take over warm demos from the outbound pipeline. Run the full cycle: discovery call, audit walkthrough, proposal, negotiation, close. The founder is in the room for your first 5 demos, then you fly solo. Target: 4–5 closed deals.
Months 4–6
Own the number
You have a pipeline, a rhythm, and a quota. You’re running 5 demos a week — 20–25 demos a month. You’re closing 4–5 deals per month at ~$20K ACV, generating $75–100K in new ACV monthly. You’re feeding objection patterns and ICP refinements back to the GTM team. You’re starting to shape how Kasparro sells, not just executing a playbook someone else wrote.
Year 1+
Build the function
Sales Lead → Head of Sales. You hire your first SDR. You own the full revenue engine: pipeline, demos, proposals, contracts, expansion. The function is yours.


WHO THIS IS FOR
You’ve done 2–4 years in B2B SaaS sales. You might be an SDR who’s been promoted to AE and closed real revenue, or a junior AE at a funded startup who’s ready for more ownership. Either way, you’ve built pipeline, navigated multi-stakeholder deals, and have a feel for when a prospect is genuinely interested vs politely stalling.
You’ve closed $500K+ in cumulative ACV across the last 12 months. You know what it takes to move a deal from first call to signed contract. You’ve worked a CRM with discipline — not because someone audited it, but because you understood that pipeline accuracy is how you forecast your own quarter.
Beyond the numbers, what matters is:
You can run a 30-minute demo without a script. You listen first, adapt on the fly, and make the buyer feel like the conversation was built for them. You ask sharper questions than you give pitches.
You sell with data, not charm. Our sale is diagnostic-led. You walk a buyer through their brand’s AI visibility scores and let the evidence create urgency. If you’re used to consultative, insight-led, data-forward selling, you’ll feel at home.
You think analytically about ICP. You don’t just work a list — you think about why certain segments convert, which buyer personas respond to which angles, and how to prioritize your pipeline based on fit signals, not just deal size. You understand that selling to a VP Marketing at a $50M D2C brand is a different conversation than selling to a Head of Growth at a $10M SaaS company — and you adjust.
You’re comfortable with US clients. Clear spoken English, cultural fluency, no hesitation on a Zoom call with a VP in San Francisco. This isn’t about accent — it’s about confidence and calibration.
You’re curious about AI and how it changes buying behavior. You don’t need to be an AI expert. But you should have asked an AI chatbot for a product recommendation at least once and wondered how it picked those brands.
You can handle ambiguity. There is no 40-page sales playbook. There is a product that works, a founder who sells well, and a market that’s waking up. You’ll be building the playbook as you go — not following one.

Bonus: Prior experience selling to marketing or growth leaders. Familiarity with SEO, martech, or analytics tools. Experience at a startup that was creating a new category rather than competing in an established one.

WHAT’S HARD ABOUT THIS ROLE
You’re selling a category most buyers don’t know exists yet. AI visibility is not a line item in anyone’s budget today. Your job is to make it one. That means the first 30 seconds of every conversation is education, not pitch. If you need a warm market where buyers already know what they’re shopping for, this isn’t it.
The team is small. You’ll work directly with the founder and a lean GTM squad. There is no sales ops team formatting your proposals, no enablement team building your battle cards, no RevOps person cleaning your CRM. You do your own work. The upside is that you shape everything — the downside is that everything is yours to shape.
Evening and late-night calls are part of the job. Not every day, but a US-facing sales role from Bengaluru means some 7 PM–12 AM calls. If you want a strict 9-to-6, this won’t work.

ABOUT KASPARRO
Kasparro is an AI Visibility platform. We help brands get discovered, recommended, and chosen by AI engines — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Mode. As buyers increasingly start their research inside AI assistants, being recommended (or ignored) by those engines becomes a commercial issue. That’s the gap we close.
We don’t just measure the problem — we fix it. Our engagement spans four product layers: monitoring and intelligence across AI engines, on-site technical fixes and content to make a brand’s owned surfaces machine-readable, off-site engagement to shape the narrative AI sees everywhere else (Reddit, reviews, YouTube, Wikipedia), and authority and citation building to earn the trust signals AI engines rely on. Each client gets a dedicated Brand Engineer who runs the full stack: strategy, brief creation, output QA, coordination with the client’s teams, and measurable outcomes.
We’re backed by experienced founders, CMOs, and angels. We’re small, fast-moving, and building quickly in HSR Layout, Bengaluru.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
When a brand signs with Kasparro, they’re not buying a report. They’re buying a dedicated operator who understands their brand goals, diagnoses where they’re invisible or misrepresented by AI engines, drives the technical and content fixes that close those gaps, shapes how AI sees them across every off-site surface, tracks the outcomes, and expands the engagement as results land.
Today the founder plays that role for every client. That doesn’t scale. This role exists to be that operator — the Brand Engineer who owns the full client lifecycle from onboarding through ongoing delivery, outcomes, and expansion — and to build the delivery function as the client base grows.
The Brand Engineer writes the brief. The Kasparro platform and team generate the output — technical fixes, content, engagement plays, monitoring reports. The Brand Engineer QAs the output, delivers it to the client, coordinates implementation with the client’s agencies or internal teams, tracks what moved, and shapes the next month’s strategy based on the results.

WHAT THE WORK LOOKS LIKE
The client. VP Marketing, Head of E-commerce, Head of Growth, or founder — typically at companies doing $10M–$100M+ in revenue, spending $2M–$20M on digital marketing annually. US and India. These are people who bought Kasparro because they saw evidence that AI engines are ignoring or misrepresenting their brand — and understood the commercial impact. They’re data-literate, they run agencies or internal marketing and tech teams, and they expect you to be the single point of accountability for AI visibility across their brand.
The four product layers. Every engagement runs on a combination of monitoring and intelligence (how AI engines see the brand, tracked continuously), on-site fixes and content (making the brand’s owned surfaces — site, product pages, landing pages — machine-readable and extractable), off-site engagement (shaping how the brand is discussed on Reddit, Quora, YouTube, reviews, Wikipedia), and authority and citation building (earning the backlinks, press placements, and trust signals that AI engines rely on when forming recommendations). The mix and depth varies by client. You run all active layers for each account.
The workflow. You translate the client’s brand goals and visibility gaps into specific briefs — what pages need schema fixes, what content to create, which off-site surfaces to engage, what authority plays to run. The Kasparro platform and team generate the outputs from your briefs. You QA every output before it reaches the client. Then you deliver it, coordinate implementation with the client’s agencies or internal tech and marketing teams, measure what moved, and use the data to shape the next cycle.
The strategy layer. You run monthly strategy reviews with each client. You translate monitoring data into business language: where the brand is being recommended, where it’s being excluded, which competitors are displacing it, and what to fix next. When a VP Marketing at a $50M D2C brand asks “why are we losing the comparison to our top competitor?” — you show them the exact gaps in how AI engines see both brands, and you walk them through the fix plan.
The geography. US and India clients. Most US interactions are async — Loom walkthroughs, documented briefs, Slack. Live calls happen 1–3 evenings a week. India meetings are in-person or daytime video.

WHAT YOU OWN
Client delivery across all product layers. You run the monthly delivery cycle for each account: write the briefs, QA the outputs, deliver to the client, coordinate implementation, and track completion. Nothing slips. SLAs are yours — delivery timelines, response windows, follow-up cadence. The tracking system is always current.
Strategic client engagement. You don’t just deliver outputs — you run strategy. Monthly reviews where you translate monitoring data into prioritized actions based on the client’s brand goals. You shape what gets fixed this month, what content gets created, and which off-site surfaces get attention — and you explain why in terms of business outcomes, not technical jargon.
Brief writing and output QA. You write the briefs that drive every fix, content piece, and engagement play. The platform and team generate the outputs. You QA every output against the client’s brand voice, accuracy standards, and delivery checklist before it goes out. You’re the quality gate.
Agency and team coordination. Most clients have existing SEO, PR, content, or community agencies — or internal tech and marketing teams. You don’t replace them. You brief them on what needs to happen, provide the specifications, and track execution. You’re the intelligence and coordination layer; they’re the implementation arms.
Outcomes tracking and expansion. You own the scoreboard. The client’s AI visibility scores move (or don’t) based on what you drove. You track the relationship between fixes and outcomes, build the evidence case, and use that data to drive net revenue expansion — tier upgrades, new product layers, additional brand coverage. You don’t cold-sell; the data makes the case.
Voice of Customer and product feedback. You surface patterns to the founder, tech, and product teams: recurring client needs, delivery friction, feature gaps, and — critically — where agentic automation can replace manual work. When you notice the same brief type being written for every client, that’s an automation suggestion. When you see a QA step that AI tools could handle, you flag it with specifics.

Scale to 10–15 accounts, build the system

You’re producing weekly Voice of Customer briefs. You’re flagging to tech and product where agentic automation can replace manual work. You’re documenting every recurring workflow into a playbook. Clients ask for you by name.

Build the function

You’ve done 3–5 years in a role where you owned client outcomes — customer success, solutions engineering, implementation consulting, technical account management, or AEO/SEO delivery at an agency or SaaS company. You can translate a brand’s poor visibility on non-branded queries into a commercial story about lost consideration share, and then specify the exact fixes that close the gap.
You coordinate across teams without authority. You’ll brief agencies, dev teams, PR teams, and community managers — none of whom report to you. You get things done through clarity of the brief, strength of the evidence, and the quality of your working relationships.

You spot automation opportunities. When you do the same thing manually across five clients, your instinct is to flag it as an automation candidate. You think about where AI tools and agentic workflows can replace repetitive work — and you bring specific suggestions, not vague complaints.

Bonus: Experience in AEO, GEO, or SEO delivery. Background at a digital marketing agency, martech company, or SaaS platform in a client-facing delivery role. Familiarity with schema markup, structured data, and technical SEO concepts.

As a member of our Graphics System team, you will help analyze and develop our next generation graphics core for mobile devices. • Develop tools to identify/quantify performance bottlenecks efficiently
• Correlate Pre-Si Performance on Design with Post Si
• Give feedback to Architects to plan future GPU configurations based on Market Requirements
• Develop Modeling strategies for new features that impact Power and Performance
• Perform conformance tests, stress & random tests and stabilize GPUs & Compute systems
• Interact with SOC/ DDR / MMU teams to understand System Level Performance Impact of GPU workloads
• Research, development, and delivery of Qualcomm's Adreno GPU compiler products

Role Purpose
A result-oriented Software Developer to develop solutions powered by Fujitsu’s new processor, which help solve real-world challenges facing society and businesses across different industries. As a software developer, you are passionate about developing solutions and should be comfortable with back-end coding languages, technologies, frameworks and third-party/opensource libraries. You will play a role in developing innovative advanced solutions and services to support business outcomes.
Responsibilities
• Improve and analyze the performance of software applications.
• Enable and optimize OSS/ISV AI-based applications for Fujitsu’s new processor.
• Develop new algorithms for ML/DL frameworks, tuning technologies and work on software based on the proposed approaches using AI framework engineering.
• Designing and developing AI workflows, applications, effective APIs and the system architectures
• Optimize and scale AI/ML frameworks on HPC architectures (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX)
• Develop performance tuning strategies using vectorization, threading (OpenMP, TBB), or SIMD/SVE.
• Benchmark performance and memory usage across AI workloads and Contribute to the development of inference pipelines for large-scale models (LLMs, GNNs, etc.).
• Improve and analyze performance of Generative AI & LLM Models for inferencing and fine tuning.
• Provide feedback and patches to OSS communities (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, etc.)
• Design Confidential AI Software SDKs for secure platforms on trusted execution environment using Arm Confidential Computing Architecture (CCA)
• Develop and validate Scientific ML models (e.g., PINNs, DeepONets, AI Surrogate models) to approximate solutions for physical systems (PDEs, Multiphysics, etc.)
• Troubleshooting, debugging, and fixing bugs and upgrading software/applications.
• Writing technical documentation
Key Performance Indicators
• Number of software applications enabled and optimized for Fujitsu’s new processor.
• Number of software applications with improved performance
• Development of new software technologies
Experience

• Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computational Science, Mathematics & Computing or relevant field.
• Knowledge and familiarity with common stacks for software applications
• Knowledge of HPC, AI frameworks, or systems programming
• Understanding of OSS AI Frameworks and performance optimization techniques
• Proficiency with fundamental back-end server-side languages such as Python, C++, C
• Preferred experience in AI framework or accelerators, performance tuning & optimization techniques
• Experience in software development in agile approach
• Excellent writing, verbal communication, and teamwork skills
Preferred Experience
You will be able to demonstrate that you have:
• Knowledge in developing and deploying APIs.
• Knowledge of Cloud service (Azure/AWS) features such as Functions, VM, Container, DevOps (CI/CD)
• Great skills in evaluating performance and security of software applications and delivering solutions which are efficient and performant.
• HPC and computer architecture understanding.
• Skills in AI-related technologies
• Contributions to OSS AI or HPC projects.
• Familiarity with CPU architecture internals and AI model deployment.
• Understanding of numerical computing, linear algebra libraries, and HPC AI optimization.

Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We’re not just a platform — we’re your partner in transforming dreams into reality.

Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho (Meri shop) started with a single idea in mind to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable 100 million small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and an affordable shipping cost., growing their business by tapping the company’s massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and in-house logistics arm Valmo in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers. About the Role
Love playing with codes? Emerging technologies get you all excited? Then you will fit right in
with our Machine Learning team.
We are seeking a passionate and skilled Machine Learning Engineer with 1-2 years of experience
to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in real-time serving, deep

data scientists, software engineers, and other stakeholders to deploy and manage machine

learning systems.

systems and applications.

Rapido is India's leading bike-taxi platform, revolutionizing urban mobility across ~100 cities, and expanding rapidly across Autos, Rentals, Cabs, Deliveries, and more. With over 40 million users and 5 million captains, we are not just solving transportation - we are reimagining intra-city mobility at scale. optimization.

About the Role: Data Scientist (Super-Early Career Track)
We are hiring exceptionally talented data scientists from top research universities for our elite entry-level cohort. This is a high-ownership role designed for candidates who have demonstrated strong technical depth, research aptitude, and a desire to solve high-scale, real-world problems.
You will work directly with senior leadership across Data Science, Product, and Engineering to design, prototype, and productionize models that power Rapido's marketplace. We don't expect you to have all the answers - but we expect intellectual curiosity, strong
fundamentals, and a desire to build at scale.

Key Responsibilities
- Formulate and structure business problems into well-defined data science questions
- Build models for real-time prediction, optimization, recommendation, and forecasting
- Design controlled experiments (A/B tests) and causal inference studies to validate hypotheses
- Conduct advanced exploratory data analysis on multi-terabyte datasets
- Collaborate with engineering teams to productionize models and build robust ML pipelines
- Publish internal whitepapers, conduct tech talks, and contribute to Rapido's internal knowledge base
- Drive rapid prototyping and iterative model improvement based on live feedback loops
- Partner with product managers, business leaders, and operations to translate model outputs into business impact

Ideal Candidate Profile
- Master's degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Math, Operations Research,
Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field from a top-tier institution (IITs, IISc, ISI, CMU, Stanford, MIT, etc.)
- Deep understanding of statistical modeling, supervised & unsupervised learning, time series, and optimization techniques
- Proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch) and SQL
- Strong fundamentals in probability theory, linear algebra, convex optimization, and algorithms
- Hands-on experience with large-scale data (structured and unstructured), distributed systems
(Spark/Hadoop), and cloud environments (AWS/GCP preferred)
- Exposure to marketplace problems such as dynamic pricing, demand forecasting, routing optimization, supply allocation, or recommender systems is a plus
- Experience with A/B testing, causal inference, or quasi-experimental designs is highly desirable
- Research publications, open-source contributions, or top-tier ML competitions (Kaggle, ACM, ICML, NeurIPS) will be a strong plus

What We Offer
- High-impact work: build models influencing millions of rides daily
- Massive datasets: access to 100+ TB of real-time data across cities and products
- Mentorship from top industry leaders and domain experts
- Flat, high-trust, ownership-driven culture with very fast learning curves
- Solve real-world, highly complex marketplace and logistics problems
- Exposure to cutting-edge work in marketplace design, ML systems, causal inference, experimentation, and decision science
- The opportunity to shape India's mobility and contribute to problems at true national scale

This is not just a first job. This is your launchpad.

Come build the future of mobility with us at Rapido.

About GlobalFoundries
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GF makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

Internship Program Overview:
Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives.

Summary of Role:
You will be working as intern in AI research team developing solutions to accelerate GlobalFoundries product development (IP, PDK and specs). You will be collaborating with experienced AI researchers in the team and with semiconductor domain experts to perform data extraction, engineering and cleaning to develop datasets for training LLM models and to create knowledge graphs. You will also perform experiments with various tokenizers, embedding models and techniques to measure quality and performance of AI generated responses.
Essential Responsibilities include:
• Data extraction from semiconductor domain datasets
• Data engineering and cleaning to convert them into LLM trainable formats
• Experiment with various tokenizers, embedding models and technique to compare quality and performance

Other Responsibilities:
• Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
Required Qualifications:
• Education – At least 2nd year of Masters or PhD degree in Artificial intelligence or Computer Science fields through an accredited degree program during the time of internship.
• Must have at least an overall 6.0 GPA and be in good academic standing.
• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)
• Must be willing to come on-site to GlobalFoundries office.
• Ability to work at least 40 hours per week during the internship.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Prior related internship or co-op experience
• Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc.
• Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Strong planning & organizational skills
• Must have solved puzzles in online leader boards like Kaggle
• Must be proficient with Python, Pandas, Numpy, SQL, Graph-Search
• Must be proficient with computer vision, OpenCV, CNNs
• Experience with semiconductors design and automation is a plus
• Proficiency in using HuggingFace, LangChain, Ollama is a plus

About GlobalFoundries
GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

Introduction:
This position is for Integration & Yield Engineer in GLOBALFOUNDRIES' India center at Bangalore, supporting 200 and 300mm wafer fabs in US, Singapore, and Germany. The candidate will be responsible for electrical characterization, yield analysis, and production lots disposition to drive product yield, line yield and manufacturing operations.

Your Job
• Production Sustaining: Monitoring electrical performance tends, disposition of holds at electrical and sort test, support general/urgent fab operational issues, scrap investigation, analysis for process change review boards
• Candidate will drive yield enhancement for multiple products by analyzing failing electrical parameters and rapidly data mining to investigate root causes and containing excursions and protecting supply
• Develop and improve yield characterization and data analysis methodologies to rapidly determine yield limiters, correlation to in-line defectivity and metrology, and electrical parametric signals
• Support process module engineering activities through electrical test, inline metrology, and yield analysis to improve cost, cycle-time, and manufacturing robustness
• Clear reporting and communication of issues to home teams on a daily basis
• Must be flexible in job assignment and ready to work on weekend shifts on a rotational basis as required by the business

Required Qualifications
• Education: MS/MTech is preferred Specialization on Microelectronics/VLSI or related fields
• A strong working knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC), Structured Problem Solving (SPS) skills and Failure Mode & Effect Analytical (FMEA) methods would be essential
• Good understanding of semiconductor process technology and devices
• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively within a globally matrixed team or environment
• Organized, proactive, excellent analytical skills, on-time delivery of work assigned, and good verbal and written communication
• Good knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
• Scripting and coding skills (especially R and Python) are desirable

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

About the Team
At Navi, our technology teams are at the core of building scalable, reliable, and intelligent systems that power financial services for millions of Indians. Depending on your alignment, you may work in:
Engineering Team: Builds the backbone of Navi’s financial products including lending, payments, insurance, investments, and debt management. Focuses on distributed systems, scalable architecture, and automation to deliver seamless experiences at scale.
Data Platform Team: Builds core infrastructure and tools to collect, store, process, and analyze data at scale. Powers batch and real-time pipelines, enabling self-serve capabilities across Analytics, Data Science, and Product.
Machine Learning Platform Team: Develops scalable and cost-effective ML infrastructure, including centralized feature stores, auto-training frameworks, in-house model serving, and real-time monitoring systems. Also builds standalone feature-extraction apps that serve as Navi’s core IP.
GenAI Team: Embeds advanced AI into Navi’s products: transforming lending, payments, insurance, and investments with cutting-edge GenAI solutions. Works at the intersection of deep tech and real-world impact.
All teams share the same DNA: solving challenging technical problems, shipping fast, and scaling what works.
About the Role
As an SDE-I at Navi, you will design, build, and maintain high-performance systems that solve real-world business and customer problems. From day one, you’ll take end-to-end ownership: understanding requirements, designing scalable solutions, writing clean code, and deploying/monitoring in production. You’ll be expected to write clean, maintainable code, participate in peer reviews, and deliver with speed and quality in a dynamic environment.
This role is best suited for someone who values ownership, adaptability and technical rigor, and is eager to learn and grow in a high-performance setting.

Write clean, efficient, and testable code in at least one programming language.
Contribute to designing scalable systems and services.
Debug, optimize, and improve performance of existing applications.
Collaborate with peers and product teams to deliver business-critical features.
Take ownership of assigned modules and deliver with accountability.
Continuously learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and best practices.

Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Design.

Solid understanding of databases, operating systems, and basic networking concepts.
Collaborative attitude and willingness to learn fast in a dynamic environment.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work through ambiguity and build solutions in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset, eagerness to learn quickly, and willingness to take ownership.

Our Culture

We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values to see what drives us every day.
If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

What You’ll Do
Come join the Cisco Silicon One team and participate in the design and verification of leading-edge multimillion gate ASICs. Cisco Silicon One is an industry leading Networking Silicon used in all the core Cisco products. These silicon chips are used to build high density, high speed multi-protocol switches and routers. The ASICs have the network and fabric interfaces and have a rich feature set that includes multiple high bandwidth ports, low-latency, hybrid buffers, queuing, scheduling, congestion management and industry leading NPL based NPU.

Innovative ASIC Engineering positions available in:
• ASIC Design and Verification
• ASIC Physical Design
• ASIC DFT Engineer

Who You Are?
• The requirement is for 2026 graduates only.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work toward long-term goals.
• Solid understanding of engineering fundamentals and technical problem-solving skills.
• Experience in establishing and sustaining strong relationships with the extended team.
• Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
• Knowledge in Hardware design, the test/verification environment is designed using an object-oriented framework designed in using UVM so you will use knowledge from your programming courses that include advance data structures, algorithms, and design patterns as well as languages such as System Verilog HDL / C / C++ / Python.
• The employee will aid in the architecture of the test environments which include developing constrained random stimulus generators, automated response checkers, and advanced configuration and programming API components using UVM.
• Some of these components are reused across the entire phase of the project from module, chip, and system level verification on Linux based Verilog simulators.
• Problem solving skills and out-of-the-box thinking to create area and power efficient hardware designs as well as reusable UVM classes for the verification and simulation environments.
• Physical Implementation of blocks, clock trees, Static Timing Analysis, DFT, Logic Equivalence Checks are part of the Physical Design specialist profile.
• Writing thorough and detailed specifications and test plans as well as oral descriptions will enable your ideas and concepts to be reviewed and accepted by other team members.
• Team-player, can-do attitude will work well in a group environment while still being able to contribute on an individual basis and you will find that you'll have lots of fun and thrive in this environment if you enjoy being challenged, learning new ideas, and push yourself to achieve aggressive technology goals.

Why Cisco
#WeAreCisco, where each person is unique, but we bring our talents to work as a team and make a difference powering an inclusive future for all.
We embrace digital, and help our customers implement change in their digital businesses. Some may think we’re “old” (39 years strong) and only about hardware, but we’re also a software company. And a security company. We even invented an intuitive network that adapts, predicts, learns, and protects. No other company can do what we do – you can’t put us in a box!
But “Digital Transformation” is an empty buzz phrase without a culture that allows for innovation, creativity, and yes, even failure (if you learn from it.)
Day to day, we focus on the give and take. We give our best, give our egos a break, and give of ourselves (because giving back is built into our DNA.) We take accountability, bold steps, and take difference to heart. Because without diversity of thought and a dedication to equality for all, there is no moving forward.

Position will be owning, executing & realizing results per allocated Project & contribute to short-term & long-term dept. goals & objectives, major responsibilities include.
• Understands & attains execution know-how of all Lam Business Processes, Standards & Compliances, Best Practices.

o Participate & contribute to Idea generation forums and contribute to innovative solutions

• Knowledge of machining, welding, molding, sheet-metal fabrication & casting processes
• Hands-on Projects that include Engineering Maturity, Prototyping, Build and Prove.
Nice to know:
• Advanced manufacturing methods – Additive Manufacturing and 3D printing, Water jet machining, Ceramic manufacturing
• Experience with concept development using any 3D CAD - Modelling, Assembly & dwg
• Use of simulation tools such as Ansys, Nastran, Creo Simulate etc.

The Global Data Science and Innovation (DSI) unit of KANTAR, nested within its Analytics Practice (https://www.kantar.com/expertise/analytics), is a fast-growing team of niche, elite data scientists responsible for all data science led innovation within KANTAR. The unit has a strong internal and external reputation with global stakeholders and clients, of handling sophisticated cutting-edge analytics, using state-of-the-art techniques and deep mathematical / statistical rigor. The unit is responsible for bringing in a lot of latest developments in the field of Machine Learning, AI, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, Optimization, etc. to solve complex business problems in marketing analytics and consulting and build products that empower our colleagues around the world.

Job Profile Summary:
As part of a high-profile team, the position offers a unique opportunity to work first-hand on some of the most unique, exciting, and challenging projects within the organization, and be part of a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. One gets to work on and influence cutting-edge work with peers from top universities from India, US, and other parts of the world.
You will be constantly learning and trying out new things, dealing with complex technical problems, thinking on first principles, using the latest in the fields of Data Science. You don’t need to know everything yet, but you DO need to have a passion for learning and the flexibility and stamina to do so. You should be able to quickly bring several creative technical ideas to fruition - knowing fully well some may work, and some won’t. You need to be flexible, work well in teams, own your work, and be a good collaborator. Nothing gets done in isolation at Kantar. As such, you need to be a fast learner, a very good problem solver, and an incredibly good coder. These skills are arguably more important than the specific methodologies or technologies that you may know.
If this sounds like you, we look forward to meeting you soon at your campus.

Job Details:
✓ Designation: Data Scientist
✓ CTC -18.5 LPA (fixed).
✓ Location: Chennai

Detailed Job Description
Candidate will be responsible for the following.
✓ Application of sophisticated data science techniques to address a variety of business / marketing problems.
✓ Build, implement, deploy, and maintain state-of-the-art statistical models including machine learning, text analytics, computer vision,
Generative AI etc. across many different industries.
✓ Work with any kind of data - structured (CRM, survey, billing, behavioral etc.) or unstructured (text, image, audio, video etc.).
✓ Using software such as R, Python, SAS, Gauss etc. to analyze different kinds of data (structured or unstructured).
✓ Should be able to appreciate high-level business objectives, and how that translates to technical questions, and execute with efficiency and
impact.
✓ Interpreting results of quantitative analyses and creating recommendations that link modelling results to business issues.
✓ Collaborate in a multi-functional team (dev ops, data engineers, front-end developers, cloud architects, operations, researchers, and product
owners) and diverse global stakeholders to develop scalable processes and protocols for executing analytics at scale.
✓ Attitudinally entrepreneurial, willing to try out new things, explore. Keep abreast of latest developments in the industry and bring in those
learnings from allied fields into our context.

Expected Skills and Proficiencies:
✓ 0 to 3 years’ experience with strong written and verbal communication skills. Meticulous and deep attention to detail.
✓ Proficiency in programming is a must (R / Python at least at an intermediate level). More than the libraries you have used, we are interested in
your ability to develop solutions and translate ideas into code quickly and effectively.
✓ A healthy mix of strong technical depth in data science, as well as consultative capabilities preferred – (we are a technical team, so your
technical competence will be given more weightage!).
✓ Knowledge / Experience in building applications on cloud platforms like Azure/AWS/Google Cloud using serverless architecture is an added
advantage.
✓ In general, a natural ability to learn and deploy new technologies in the field of Data Science, cloud computing, and application development.
✓ Strong statistics background would be a distinct advantage. Some database background (SQL, Hadoop etc.) will be an added advantage.
✓ Be able to appreciate ‘big picture’ and business perspective along with strong focus on execution.

Why join Kantar?
We shape the brands of tomorrow by better understanding people everywhere. By understanding people, we can understand what drives their
decisions, actions, and aspirations on a global scale. And by amplifying our in-depth expertise of human understanding alongside groundbreaking
technology, we can help brands find concrete insights that will help them succeed in our fast-paced, ever shifting world.
And because we know people, we like to make sure our own people are being looked after as well. Equality of opportunity for everyone is our
highest priority and we support our colleagues to work in a way that supports their health and wellbeing. While we encourage teams to spend
part of their working week in the office, we understand no one size fits all; our approach is flexible to ensure everybody feels included,
accepted, and that we can win together. We’re dedicated to creating an inclusive culture and value the diversity of our people, clients, suppliers
and communities, and we encourage applications from all backgrounds and sections of society. Even if you feel like you’re not an exact match,
we’d love to receive your application and talk to you about this job or others at Kantar.

- Contribute to all phases of data science projects — from business understanding, data preparation, and exploratory analysis to model development, evaluation, and deployment.

- Proficiency in Linux environments and version control systems (Git, GitHub).
- Experience with Docker (or equivalent containerization tools such as CRI-O or Podman); knowledge of Kubernetes is a plus.
- Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Strong collaboration, problem-solving, and time management skills.

Job Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore
Team Overview:
The Applied Research & Technology (ART) team, part of Collins Aerospace, works with teams around the globe, collaborating with them towards building prototypes, demonstrators, and new products, thereby enabling better innovation and business outcomes for Collins Aerospace.
The Emerging Technologies (ART ET) team, part of ART, pursues advanced, emerging, and disruptive technologies and methods relevant to multiple strategic business units (SBUs) with a focus on AI/ML and AR/VR technologies.
An overview of the ART team can be found in the link below:
https://www.collinsaerospace.com/what-we-do/technology-and-innovation/applied-research-and-technology
Role Overview:
We are seeking a highly motivated individual to grow and develop the ART – Emerging Technologies team. The individual will provide technical leadership to multiple advanced and disruptive technology projects, collaborating with diverse stakeholders across the globe. They will also guide teams in delivering successful Proofs of Concept, technology demonstrators, and new product developments.
We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about AI/ML technology development, with a strong background in developing AI/ML applications and a sound knowledge of aerospace products and services. The ideal candidate will be an active communicator, an effective influencer, and comfortable operating in the dynamic, fast-changing environment of research and innovation.
Responsibilities & Duties: 
• Drive end-to-end execution of AI-/ML projects, from requirements definition and architecture design to technology stack selection, development, and deployment.
• Advance innovation by conducting state-of-the-art research, identifying relevant AI/ML technologies for engineering use cases, and securing customer confidence through successful design reviews.
• Strengthen client stakeholder partnerships by serving as the primary point of contact for project updates, risks, and change management.
• Shape technology strategy by tracking and evaluating emerging AI/ML trends and industry disruptions, translating them into actionable opportunities.
• Elevate organizational visibility through active participation in international AI/ML conferences and symposiums, publishing high-impact research and white papers.
Key Competencies & Skillsets: 
• Strong domain knowledge of using AI/ML to develop AI-assisted engineering solutions and AI enabled products.
• Knowledge and exposure on agentic AI frameworks for software development, AI copilots for engineering workflows, or intelligent automation tools that accelerate product development.
• Proficiency in at least two languages (Python, C, C++, C#, or Java), with the ability to architect and deliver production-grade, scalable solutions.
• Strong knowledge and understanding of MLOps pipeline is a plus.
• Depth in NLP, CV, or Data Analytics, with working knowledge of others. Exposure to GenAI/XAI is a plus.
• Clear communicator with ability to drive cross-functional outcomes.
• Strong orientation toward compliance, safety, and process rigor.
• Thrives in fast-paced, accountable environments with discipline and reliability. 
• Proficiency in Python and AI/ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers).
Basic Qualifications:
• Required Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science engineering, Electrical /Electronic & Communications Engineering or other fields of engineering with specializations in AI/ML.
• Experience with product development is a plus

• Well versed with PHM (Prognostic Health Monitoring) concepts of feature engineering, anomaly detection, model performance metrics, signal processing, statistical analysis
• Knowledge on Physics based analytics & physics informed Machine Learning approaches
• Solid foundation in machine learning algorithms (regression, classification, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting).
Job Description:
• Develop physics based analytics & physics informed machine learning–based analytics for sensory data from aircraft systems (e.g., engines, actuators, fuel and air conditioning systems).
• Work closely with SMEs, design engineers, and PHM teams to understand the physical behavior of systems and translate it into analytical models.
• Analyze and process large-scale time-series data using Databricks, PySpark, and distributed computing frameworks.
• Develop fault detection, degradation tracking, and anomaly detection algorithms using statistical and ML methods.
• Integrate physics-based features (derived from thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, or system modeling) with ML models for improved interpretability and accuracy.
• Perform feature engineering, dimensionality reduction, and signal fusion across multiple sensors and systems.
• Validate and verify analytics using test data and SME feedback, ensuring physical consistency and robustness.
• Collaborate in the development of digital twins, prognostics and health management (PHM) models, and predictive maintenance frameworks.
Other Preferred skill sets that are nice to have:
• Experience developing physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) or hybrid physics + ML models.
• Knowledge of prognostics and health management (PHM), RUL (Remaining Useful Life) estimation, and system-level health modeling.
• Familiarity with simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink, Modelica, NPSS) for validation and model correlation.
• Experience with digital twin frameworks or model-based system engineering (MBSE) environments.
• Exposure to cloud-based analytics, CI/CD pipelines, and MLflow for model management.

Analog Devices is seeking highly motivated and skilled Engineers with strong foundation
in embedded systems, hardware/software development, and communication skills. This
role is a fantastic opportunity for a professional to work in a dynamic environment and
collaborate across teams to support the adoption of our products across wide range of
applications, including Automotive, Consumer, Industrial, and multimarket.
Roles & Responsibilities:
• Design and develop comprehensive reference designs, including both software
and hardware solutions, for emerging interfaces on ADI products.
• Perform functional and system-level validation, with a focus on compliance
testing for high-speed interfaces such as DDR, USB, SPDIF, and Ethernet.
• Customize reference designs to meet customer-specific requirements, ensuring
seamless integration with ADI processors.
• Collaborate directly with Tier-1 and OEM customers (on-site or off-site) to resolve
technical challenges and accelerate their transition to production.
• Create technical documentation, articles, proof of concept platforms, and
deliver training sessions to customers and internal ADI sales/support teams.
• Act as a key liaison between customers and our product development teams,
providing valuable feedback for the definition of next-generation products.
• Analyze system-level requirements for targeted markets and applications,
working with cross-functional teams to drive product definition and execution.
Candidate Qualifications:
1. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering,
with strong fundamentals in Digital Signal Processing and
microprocessors/microcontrollers.
2. Core Skills:
1. Strong foundational knowledge of Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and
microprocessors/microcontrollers.
2. Proficiency in C programming is mandatory.
3. Solid understanding of electronics engineering and familiarity with standard
communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, and UART.
3. Desired Experience:
1. Hands-on experience with DSP algorithm implementation and optimization
on processors.
2. Experience with Python and/or assembly programming
3. Familiarity with tools like MATLAB.
4. Personal Attributes
1. Exceptional interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills.
2. Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects
and prioritize effectively.
3. Self-motivated, innovative, and a positive team contributor.
5. Travel: Willingness to travel domestically or internationally (10%–15%).

Adapter Development:

● Familiarity with PostgreSQL and a basic understanding of NoSQL databases.
● Exposure to development tools such as Babel, Webpack, and NPM.

Bajaj Auto Limited (BAL) runs one of the most advanced automotive R&D centers in Asia, backed by years of expertise in technology, design, and innovation. With 1,500+ engineers and over 1,200 patents across India and 20+ countries, BAL R&D is the powerhouse driving Bajaj’s reputation as a global leader in engineering excellence. By continuously investing in infrastructure, digital tools, and talent, Bajaj R&D sets new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and future-ready mobility solutions. There are primarily 2 areas that BAL R&D GTEs can be deployed in, Design and Testing & Validation.
As a Graduate Trainee Engineer (GTE) in Design, you will lead the end-to-end design and development of next-generation Bajaj vehicles — from concept and layout to production readiness. You’ll work in horizontal teams (Powerpack, Structural & Transmission, Rolling Chassis, Engine, Lighting, etc.) or vertical teams (Vehicle, Powertrain), collaborating across disciplines to deliver integrated, production-ready designs. In Testing & Validation, you will ensure that every Bajaj vehicle meets the highest standards of performance, durability, and safety. You’ll work on both physical and virtual validation, pushing designs to their limits and ensuring excellence before they hit the road.


Key Responsibilities
➢ End-to-End Product Development: Lead vehicle and component design from concept definition to production readiness.
➢ Benchmarking & Target Setting: Define weight, cost, and performance goals through competitive benchmarking and ensure adherence to project budgets.
➢ 3D Modeling & Engineering Analysis: Develop layouts, perform vehicle-level calculations, and establish hard points and modular variants.
➢ Design & Validation Planning: Create and execute Design Verification & Validation Plans (DVVPs) and Design Verification Plans (DVPs).
➢ Physical Testing & Validation: Conduct component, system, and full-vehicle testing using advanced rigs and on-road evaluations for durability, NVH, and ride performance.
➢ Virtual Simulation: Use CAE and CFD tools to simulate structural, thermal, and fluid performance, optimizing designs before prototyping.
➢ Electrical & Electronic Validation: Verify EE systems for EMI/EMC compliance and functional reliability.
➢ Prototype to SOP Support: Participate in prototype builds, pilot runs, and Start of Production (SOP) activities, resolving design and manufacturability concerns.
➢ Optimization & Value Engineering: Drive improvements for Durability, NVH, DFA, DFS, DFM, and contribute Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE) initiatives.
➢ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Testing teams to ensure seamless project execution.
➢ Data-Driven Insights: Analyze test data, prepare technical reports, and contribute to continuous design and process enhancement.

As a Packaging Engineer, you will work in the Packaging R&D group on the modelling and simulation, design of experiments and testing across semiconductor packaging, flash memory product and host levels.
• Responsible for influencing package and product design by addressing structural integrity and reliability issues and advancing the technology of semiconductor packaging in general. The scope is to address all mechanical aspects of packaging technology, including associated materials and processes. The focus will be on solutions to meet increased demands for small form factors and high-performance packages with thinner chips, more chips, denser interconnects, higher power, and higher reliability.
• Responsible for the modelling and simulation, design of experiment, and testing, whichever comes first for best engineering practice, of mechanical responses of IC package and flash products, including solid state drives.
• This position will interface with package & product design, electrical and physical characterization, reliability testing, failure analysis, assembly R&D and other process teams.
• A solid background in applied mechanics, especially computational and/or experimental solid mechanics, is required. In-depth knowledge of IC packaging is highly desired.
Qualifications
REQUIRED:
• PhD in Mechanical Engineering, or M.S. in Mechanical Engineering plus >3 years of relevant industrial experience.
• Solid knowledge through academic coursework or experience required in mechanical engineering of IC packaging and related areas.
• Strong background in computational solid mechanics and/or experimental solid mechanics with emphasis on failure analysis and design of experiments.
• Broad knowledge of mechanical behaviors of various material types, including composite laminates, polymers, and metals (e.g., solder).
• Working knowledge of designing and conducting mechanical testing and/or using a commercial FEA package.
• Good understanding of general semiconductor packaging processes, materials, technology, and trends, such as substrate design and manufacturing, moulding, wire-bonding, die attach, flip chip, etc.
SKILLS:
• Strong oral and written communication skills.
• Demonstrated a strong work ethic.
• Ability to work in a global team environment and interact with other engineers to define and implement experiments and conduct relevant simulations for feasibility and validation of concepts, and provide design solutions to support new package technology development.

Founder’s Office - Business Strategy & Tech Strategy
Location:
Bangalore


At Ola, the vision is to build the technologies of the future. With technology at its core, the company is focused on creating businesses of global impact out of India, for the world. It is believed that India has a golden opportunity and a destined responsibility to develop world-class products, and it is this generation’s duty to turn that vision into reality for the nation. 
Ola's brand ethos is centered around impact and purpose-driven business development. The company fosters a culture of impact and empowers its colleagues with the spirit of true entrepreneurship. It is committed to discovering the best talent and providing them with diverse opportunities to lead high-impact projects. 
A purpose-driven individual is being sought to join the office and work closely with the leadership team, contributing to the company's goals. The aim is to build a team of co-pilots who will collaborate with leadership across verticals, working with a highly skilled talent pool to drive the development of cutting-edge products and services. 
Working at Ola would mean that you will define the company's vision & strategy as well as help make it a reality. With immense growth opportunities, you will be an integral part of the decision-making team at the leadership level, helping us achieve speed and scale of operations. 
If you ever dream of taking the plunge as a future leader to bring in a change and create history, come join us! #BuildTheFuture with Ola. 
Key Requirements 
We are looking for dynamic, purpose-driven individuals to join the Founder’s Office and work closely with Ola’s leadership team across Ola Cabs, Ola Electric, and Krutrim. As a part of this role, you will: 
● Directly report to Bhavish Aggarwal and collaborate with senior leaders who bring 25-30+ years of industry experience. 
● Work across multiple business verticals, driving strategic initiatives, problem-solving, and decision-making at the highest level. 
● Engage in cross-functional projects that demand critical thinking, structured problem-solving, and execution excellence. 
● Be at the forefront of innovation and impact, shaping Ola’s future in Mobility, EV, and AI.

This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to work directly with industry veterans, drive large-scale impact, and be at the heart of Ola’s next phase of growth.
","Selection Process

To identify the best talent for this high-impact role, we will follow a structured four-stage selection process: 1. Profile-Based Shortlisting 
Candidates will be shortlisted based on: 
➔ Statement of Purpose (SOP): Showcasing your purpose, resilience, and achievements. ➔ Work Experience: Demonstrating leadership potential and problem-solving ability. 
➔ Academic & Extracurricular Achievements: Highlighting strategic thinking and execution skills.
 2. Group Discussion (GD) 
Shortlisted candidates will participate in a GD round, where we assess: 
➔ Clarity of Thought: How well you articulate and structure your ideas. 
➔ Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Your ability to evaluate and break down complex problems. ➔ Leadership & Collaboration: How effectively you engage with peers in a high-stakes discussion. 
3. Interview Rounds with Senior Leadership 
Candidates clearing the GD will undergo three rounds of interviews with senior leaders from different business verticals, focusing on: 
➔ Business Acumen & Problem-Solving 
➔ Cross-Functional Collaboration 
➔ Execution & Impact-Driven Thinking 
4. Final Interaction with Bhavish Aggarwal 
➔ In the final stage, shortlisted candidates will have a one-on-one interaction with Bhavish Aggarwal to assess their alignment with Ola’s vision, leadership expectations, and strategic goals. This discussion will also provide insights into the company’s long-term objectives and the candidate’s potential impact.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Research Scholar to join our Power Electronics research group. The candidate will work on cutting-edge research projects related to power conversion systems, control techniques, energy efficiency, and advanced power semiconductor devices. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to innovative research in the field of power electronics and develop expertise in experimental setups, simulation tools, and practical design applications.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities:
• Conduct independent research in power electronics, focusing on areas such as:
o DC-DC, AC-DC, and DC-AC converters
o Wide-bandgap devices (SiC, GaN)
o Advanced modulation and control strategies (e.g., PLL, predictive control)
o Power quality analysis and mitigation
o Grid-connected inverters and renewable integration
• Design, simulate, and develop power electronics prototypes using tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, PSIM, or LTspice.
• Perform experimental validation of research concepts using laboratory setups (e.g., hardware-in-the-loop testing, FPGA-based control implementation).
• Prepare technical reports, project documentation, and thesis work in a structured manner.
• Collaborate with academic and industrial research partners.
• Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in power electronics and related technologies.
________________________________________
Required Qualifications:
• Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
• Strong understanding of power electronics principles, semiconductor devices, and control strategies.
• Proficiency in simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, PSIM, or equivalent.
• Hands-on experience in power electronics hardware development and testing is preferred.
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication skills for documentation and publication.
________________________________________
Desired Skills (Optional but Preferred):
• Experience with real-time control platforms (e.g., Plecs RT Box, dSPACE, OPAL-RT, TI C2000, STM32).
• Knowledge of grid codes, power quality standards, and EMI/EMC concepts.
• Familiarity with hardware design (PCB layout, gate driver circuits, power modules).
• Experience with wide-bandgap devices (SiC, GaN) applications.

Employment Type: Full-time
Work Model: On-site
Shift: General Shift (5 days a week)
About Netradyne: Netradyne is a cutting-edge technology company revolutionizing the transportation industry with its advanced AI-powered solutions. We specialize in developing innovative products and services that enhance fleet safety, efficiency, and performance. With a focus on data-driven insights and real-time analytics, Netradyne is at the forefront of shaping the future of transportation.
Job Overview: As an Associate Data Scientist or Data Scientist at Netradyne, You will perform analyses, build models, and design/conduct experiments to improve road safety and reduce accidents
Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop and evaluate statistical, machine learning and generative AI / LLM models to understand driving risk, driver coaching and actionable insights.
• Build machine learning models and design product features to improve scores, compliance, and other key metrics.
• Develop, deploy and improve machine learning models in end-to-end ML pipeline for key features such as accident prediction.
• Design efficient architecture for real-time edge computing.
• Conduct statistical experiments, A/B Testing, and data-driven metrics to guide product ROI features.
• Work with the data engineering/ cloud team/ product team to productize data science features or microservices.
Mandatory Skills:
• B. Tech/M. Tech/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or other Quantitative Fields.
• Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, ML, and estimation theory.
• Good understanding of data-structures and algorithms.
• Experience with deriving useful insights from large and complex datasets.
• Experience with Mathematical/Statistical modeling, data visualization, and storytelling.
• Strong ability to communicate highly technical results to a diverse audience.
• Ability to develop quick proof of concept solutions in a fast-paced startup environment.
• Good hands-on experience of coding – Python (required), C/C++, R, etc.
• Experience working with databases – Postgres, MongoDB, etc.
Preferred Skills:
• Experience with prompt engineering and Generative AI foundation models is a plus.
• Experience working with time-series, rare-event detection and data from GPS/IMU sensors would be useful.
• Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Plotly-Dash is a plus.
• Experience with Big data tools like Hadoop, Spark, Mongo DB
• Fundamental understanding of deep learning and/or computer vision algorithms.
• Exposure to accelerating algorithms for GPUs, such as with CUDA, is a plus.
• Publications in CVPR, NIPS, ICLR, ICCV and IEEE journals is a plus..
  Interview Process
• 1st round: statistics, probability, ML, and estimation theory, Python, Aptitude, Puzzles, Algorithms, System level understanding, Deep diving into final year project

About Applied
Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.

Your Opportunity
This role is for candidate having a bachelor’s or master’s degree with strong academic background in (one of areas) of material science & engineering, chemical engineering, electrical engineering (specialization in VLSI/chip design), metallurgy with specialization in material science. Candidates alternatively can have educational background in sciences as Physicist, Chemist etc.
Candidate should be self-starter and can work with minimal guidance and knows how to navigate cross-functionally. They demonstrate a system thinking approach to their assignments and can synthesize information to take effect action. They can apply their fundamental theories, principles, and concepts to solve real world problems.

Roles & Responsibility
• Collect data, analyze, and compile reports on basic process engineering experiments, within safety guidelines
• Perform hardware characterization on basic systems, within safety guidelines
• Troubleshoot basic problems, perform Root Cause Analysis, and resolve basic process engineering issues
• Measure film properties and organize data/reports for review
• Generate internal documentation for products, presentations, and technical reports
• Interact with customers to resolve basic process engineering issues/problems under direct supervision
• Work with engineers, vendors, and suppliers, under direct supervision
• Become familiar with the process of implementing new technology, products, and analytical instrumentation
• Work on system engineering projects that have a substantial mix of electrical, mechanical, physics, algorithms and software design utilizing expertise in technical area of specialty.
• Perform tests and provide feedback to product engineering and software on new designs and ongoing engineering improvements.
• Problem identification and troubleshooting engineering problems in field of technical expertise, including serviceability and manufacturability.
• Work with System Integration during the assembly and final testing of all products.
• Review all external equipment interfaces, analyze architecture ideas, and insure they are up to date and documented.
• Interface with other groups on issues, ranging from Facility, HW, SW, C&F, Service to Business Value End to End.

Travel:
75% travel required

Eligibility Criteria:
Must have 7 CGPA or 70% and above in X, XII, UG & PG

Functional Knowledge
• Demonstrates conceptual knowledge of theories, practices, and procedures within a discipline

Business Expertise
• Applies general knowledge of business developed through education or experience
• Recommends best practices to improve products, processes, or services.

Leadership
• Individual contributor; accountable for developing technical contribution
• Ability to influence others independent of level and function, including external partners.
• Strong decision-making skills and record of good judgments.

Problem Solving
• Uses existing procedures to solve standard problems; analyzes information and standard practices to make judgments
• Thinks strategically to solve problems and resolve issues to manage speed of execution.
• Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions.

Impact
• Has limited impact on own work team; works within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines
• Impacts the achievement of customer, operational, project or service objectives; work is guided by mindset of innovation and commercialization of product ideas.

Interpersonal Skills
• Exchanges straightforward information, asks questions and checks for understanding
• Communicates difficult concepts and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view.

Qualification
Bachelor’s Undergraduate and/or master’s degree in material science & engineering, chemical engineering, electrical engineering (specialization in VLSI/chip design), metallurgy engineering with specialization in material science. Candidates alternatively can have educational background in sciences as Physicist, Chemist, or similar fields.

Experience
Requirement is from no experience up to two years of experience.

Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.

► Your Opportunity
This role is for candidate having a Ph.D with strong academic background in (one of areas) of material science & engineering, chemical engineering, electrical engineering (specialization in VLSI/chip design), metallurgy with specialization in material science. Candidates alternatively can have educational background in sciences as Physicist, Chemist etc.
Candidate should be self-starter and can work with minimal guidance and knows how to navigate cross-functionally. • Collect data, analyze, and compile reports on basic process engineering experiments, within safety guidelines

• Troubleshoot basic problems, perform Root Cause Analysis, and resolve basic process engineering issues
• Measure film properties and organize data/reports for review
• Generate internal documentation for products, presentations, and technical reports
• Interact with customers to resolve basic process engineering issues/problems under direct supervision
• Work with engineers, vendors, and suppliers, under direct supervision
• Become familiar with the process of implementing new technology, products, and analytical instrumentation
• Work on system engineering projects that have a substantial mix of electrical, mechanical, physics, algorithms and software design utilizing expertise in technical area of specialty.
• Perform tests and provide feedback to product engineering and software on new designs and ongoing engineering improvements.
• Problem identification and troubleshooting engineering problems in field of technical expertise, including serviceability and manufacturability.
• Work with System Integration during the assembly and final testing of all products.
• Review all external equipment interfaces, analyze architecture ideas, and insure they are up to date and documented.
• Interface with other groups on issues, ranging from Facility, HW, SW, C&F, Service to Business Value End to End.

Travel:
30% travel required

Must have 7 CGPA or 70% and above in X, XII, UG & PG

Business Expertise

Leadership

• Ability to influence others independent of level and function, including external partners.
• Strong decision-making skills and record of good judgments.

Problem Solving
• Uses existing procedures to solve standard problems; analyzes information and standard practices to make judgments
• Thinks strategically to solve problems and resolve issues to manage speed of execution.
• Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions.

Impact
• Has limited impact on own work team; works within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines
• Impacts the achievement of customer, operational, project or service objectives; work is guided by mindset of innovation and commercialization of product ideas.

Interpersonal Skills
• Exchanges straightforward information, asks questions and checks for understanding
• Communicates difficult concepts and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view.

Qualification
