About TIAA
TIAA(Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association)is a leading provider of financial services founded in 1918 by Andrew Carnegie. With over $1.3 trillion in assets under management(as of September 30,2024),TIAA serves more than 5million active and retired employees in academic, research, medical, cultural, and government fields. The company offers a wide range of financial products and services, including retirement plans, investment solutions, banking services, IRAs, life insurance, and wealth management services. Known for its nonprofit heritage and commitment to sustainable investing, TIAA has consistently received high ratings for financial strength and stability from independent rating agencies.

About TIAA Global Capabilities
TIAA Global Capabilities delivers high-quality global technology, operations and shared services to TIAA's businesses and associates. TIAA Global Capabilities' associates work closely with colleagues in the U.S. and around the world to meet the needs of its ever-growing client base. Since its inception, we have played a vital role within the broader organization and has delivered exceptional performance with highest level of operational excellence.

Join TIAA's Dynamic Cybersecurity Team and Launch Your Career in Digital Defense
Are you passionate about protecting digital assets and staying ahead of cyber threats? TIAA's Cybersecurity department is seeking talented recent graduates to join our comprehensive campus hire program. You'll gain hands-on experience across multiple cybersecurity domains while contributing to the protection of our organization's critical infrastructure and sensitive data.
What You'll Do
Threat Monitoring & Detection
• Monitor security information and event management (SIEM) platforms for suspicious activities and potential threats
• Analyze security alerts and logs to identify legitimate security incidents versus false positives
• Perform initial triage and classification of security events based on severity and impact
• Document findings and escalate confirmed threats to senior analysts and incident response teams
• Utilize various security tools and technologies to identify indicators of compromise (IOCs)
• Conduct basic forensic analysis on security incidents under guidance from senior team members
• Research emerging threats, attack patterns, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs)
• Assist in developing and refining detection rules and signatures
Vulnerability Management
• Execute vulnerability scans across enterprise networks, systems, and applications using automated tools
• Configure and maintain vulnerability scanning tools and policies to ensure comprehensive coverage
• Analyze scan results to identify genuine vulnerabilities versus false positives
• Prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk ratings, exploitability, and business impact
• Generate detailed vulnerability reports for technical teams and management & remediation planning and partnership with app & platform teams
• Support remediation validation after vulnerabilities are fixed
• Execute web application security tests using tools like Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP

Data Loss Prevention
• Monitor and analyze DLP alerts across email, web, endpoint, and network channels for potential data exfiltration
• Review and classify sensitive data incidents to determine severity and appropriate response actions
• Configure and tune DLP policies to reduce false positives while maintaining effective protection
• Investigate data movement patterns and user behaviors that may indicate unauthorized data access or transfer
• Collaborate with business units to understand legitimate data usage patterns and refine detection rules
• Perform routine system maintenance tasks such as log rotation, database cleanup, and system health checks
Threat Intelligence
• Conduct daily intelligence assessments and monitor threat detection systems
• Create threat briefings, intelligence reports, and security metrics dashboards
• Correlate threat data with organizational assets and potential impact assessments
• Participate in threat intelligence sharing communities and industry groups
• Support briefings to management and technical teams on current threat trends
• Support intelligence automation initiatives to enhance operational efficiency
• Provide 24/7 support for critical security incidents and crisis response situations
Network Security
• Contribute to the design and implementation of secure network architectures and database systems
• Participate in comprehensive vulnerability assessments and malware defense evaluations
• Document network security risks and recommend mitigation strategies
• Troubleshoot complex network security issues and develop resolution procedures
• Help develop security standards and procedures that align with organizational policies
Identity & Access Management (IAM)
• Manage user access requests for centralized applications within established SLA requirements
• Ensure proper approval workflows are followed for all access provisioning
• Process access requests while maintaining strict security controls
• Educate end users on security protocols and proper access request procedures
• Analyze access patterns to identify process improvements and develop standard operating procedures
• Build, scale and mature the Identity Systems and Processes
• Provide Product Lifecycle Engineering support for IAM / PAM / IGA Platforms and Systems
• Work on Break-Fixes and Enhancement request to target 100% automation for Access Provisioning and deprovisioning tasks
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, Service, AD, Azure Entra, SOLO, SoC teams for problem resolution and solution delivery
• Drive the IAM Compliance as per TIAA Security standards and policies.
• Actively participate in PoCs, Testing, UAT signoff, Product Evaluation, solutioning.
• Help applications onboarding on to PAM and IGA platforms
Security Engineering
Key Responsibilities
Network Security Engineering
• Assist in design, configuration, and maintenance of network security devices including firewalls, IPS/IDS, and network segmentation solutions
• Monitor network traffic patterns and analyze security logs to identify potential threats and configuration improvements
• Support implementation of network access control (NAC) policies and zero-trust architecture principles
• Participate in network security assessments and vulnerability remediation efforts
• Document network security configurations and maintain topology diagrams and security policies
Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Implementation
• Configure and deploy DLP policies across email, web, endpoint, and network channels
• Fine-tune DLP rules to balance security effectiveness with business productivity requirements
• Integrate DLP solutions with existing security infrastructure and data classification systems
• Develop custom content inspection rules and data identification patterns
• Support DLP policy testing and validation processes across different business units
Endpoint Security Management
• Manage endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions across enterprise devices
• Configure endpoint protection policies including antivirus, application control, and device encryption
• Implement and maintain mobile device management (MDM) and unified endpoint management (UEM) solutions
• Support endpoint security incident response and forensic data collection activities
• Automate endpoint security deployment and configuration management processes
SIEM Platform Engineering (Splunk)
• Design and implement Splunk data ingestion pipelines from various security tools and infrastructure components
• Develop custom dashboards, reports, and alerts for security monitoring and compliance reporting
• Create and optimize Search Processing Language (SPL) queries for threat detection and investigation
• Build correlation rules and automated response workflows within the Splunk environment
• Support Splunk infrastructure maintenance including indexer clustering and search head management
Web Application Firewall (WAF) Engineering /Operations
• Deploy and configure WAF solutions to protect web applications from common attacks (OWASP Top 10)
• Develop custom WAF rules and signatures based on application-specific requirements and threat intelligence
• Integrate WAF logging and alerting with SIEM platforms for centralized monitoring
• Perform WAF policy tuning to minimize false positives while maintaining security effectiveness
• Support web application security assessments and remediation implementation
•
Cybersecurity Development
• Design, build, test, and support security applications aligned with business requirements
• Contribute to custom security solutions and infrastructure development projects
• Build APIs and integrations between security tools to create unified security workflows and data sharing
• Develop security dashboards, reporting tools, and visualization applications for security operations teams
• Create automated security testing tools and vulnerability assessment applications
• Implement secure coding practices and conduct security code reviews for internal applications
Cyber Risk & IT Risk Management
• Establish baseline technology controls based on industry standards and best practices
• Support comprehensive IT risk assessments across diverse technology platforms
• Conduct network, infrastructure, subsidiary, and supplier risk evaluations
• Manage IT issues and findings through validation, mitigation planning, and exception processes
• Support application risk assessments including SaaS and cloud-based solutions
• Develop automated risk assessment capabilities using data analytics

What You'll Bring
Technical Foundation
• Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and database management (RDBMS & SQL).
• Knowledge of operating systems and network fundamentals
• Programming experience in one or more languages: C/C++, C#, Python, .NET Core, Angular JS.
• Understanding of web application architecture and development frameworks.
• Familiarity with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile/Waterfall methodologies.
• Experience with automation tools (Selenium, Cucumber, QTP) is a plus.
Cyber for AI / AI for Cyber
• Develop, train, and deploy machine learning models for anomaly detection, malware identification, and intrusion detection.
• Work with large datasets from security tools (firewalls, SIEMs) to build and refine AI-driven threat intelligence.
• Create AI-powered automation scripts to streamline incident response and security operations.
• Analyze user and network behavior using AI to establish baselines and detect unusual, potentially malicious activity.
• Collaborate with security analysts and incident responders to integrate AI models into existing security platforms.
• Research and apply the latest AI techniques, including large language models (LLMs), to enhance cyber defenses.
• Implement and leverage AI techniques to detect and analyze anomalies, predict threats, and enhance security operations center (SOC) capabilities.

Essential Qualities
• Recent graduate with a degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or related field
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
• Detail-oriented with ability to work in fast-paced environments
• Eagerness to learn and adapt to evolving security landscapes
• Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams

• Mentorship from experienced cybersecurity professionals

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
Could you be the full-time Post Graduate Engineer Trainee (PGET) in one of our India locations we’re looking for?
Your future role
Take on an exciting challenge and apply your engineering expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates.
You'll play a key role in driving innovation and delivering sustainable mobility solutions. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across various business units such as Rolling Stock Engineering, Rolling Stock Industrial, Digital & Integrated Systems, and Support Functions (Procurement, Quality, etc.), contributing to impactful projects and much more.
You’ll specifically take care of applying your technical knowledge to solve real-world challenges, also collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure project success.
We’ll look to you for:
•Contributing to engineering and industrial projects across different domains
•Developing innovative solutions to complex technical challenges
•Collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive project efficiency
•Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to enhance processes
•Committing to continuous learning and professional growth
•Supporting the implementation of sustainable and smart mobility solutions
All about you

•Degree in M.E./M.Tech – Final Year (Graduating in 2026)
•Specialization in Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Industrial, Production, Mechatronics, Thermal, Power, Reliability or related disciplines
•Minimum 60% or equivalent CGPA throughout academics
•Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
•Passion for technology and innovation
•Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
•Willingness to learn and adapt in a dynamic environment

Things you’ll enjoy

•Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
•Work on cutting-edge rail and mobility projects
•Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues

We are seeking passionate AI Trainee Engineers (Frontend / Backend) eager to dive deep into AI-driven solution and product development. NLP tools

agents

transformer models (BERT, T5, RoBERTa), and backend APIs

Strong fundamentals in Python and libraries like:

Python-pptx, Tesseract, etc.

o NER, Text Cleaning, Summarization, QA, Topic Modeling

• Your gateway to the practical world of AI

Course Types: Only Full-Time courses will be considered (Part Time / Correspondence Courses will not be considered).
NIOS: Students who have completed their Secondary and / or Senior Secondary course from NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) are also eligible if the other courses are full time.

Percentage: Minimum aggregate of 70% or 7 CGPA throughout academics (all marksheets in all semesters-as applicable) including the highest qualification, till the latest semester for which results have been declared at the time of appearing for the selection process. If selected, the offer will be valid only if the degree / provisional degree certificate clearly states that the student has cleared the highest qualification / Engineering in 'FIRST CLASS' post completion of the course.
Backlogs / Arrears / ATKT: No pending or active backlog / arrear / ATKT is permitted at the time of appearing for the TCS interview process.
Extended Education: No extended education would be allowed. Candidates should have completed the course in the stipulated course duration.

Gap / Break in Education: It is mandatory to declare academic gaps if any, during the period of education. Break in education should not be due to extended education (examinations cleared after the time stipulated by the Board / University). Any break in education should not exceed 24 months and is permissible only for valid reasons. Relevant document proof, as applicable, will be checked for gaps in education.
Work Experience: Students with prior work experience of up to two years are eligible to participate in this hiring process (Applicable only for post graduate students).
Age: A student should be 18 to 28 years of age to participate in the selection process.

Location: Gurgaon (on-site test locations may apply) 
Type: Full-time | Entry-level

We’re hiring engineers who build first, ask later.

At LAT, we’re not just building an aircraft – we’re building a culture. One where the best ideas win, where speed matters more than perfection, and where engineers don’t wait for instructions—they chase breakthroughs. We’re developing a new kind of short takeoff and landing (STOL) aircraft with a hybrid-electric powertrain. To do that, we’re putting together one of the most hands-on, high-agency engineering teams in the country. If you’ve ever debugged a motor controller at 2 AM or reverse-engineered a problem no textbook could solve, you’ll fit right in.

Choose Your Track:

The Airshapers
- Shape aerodynamic performance, stability, and control 
- Build aero databases, validate CFD, wind tunnel, and flight test data
Thrustsmiths
- Design and model electric/hybrid propulsion systems 
- Integrate motors, batteries, cooling, and thermal protection
Signal Crew 
- Develop flight computers, data buses, and sensor networks 
- Build and test embedded avionics hardware
Autopilots 
- Design guidance laws and autopilot loops 
- Build estimators, filters, and sensor fusion pipelines
Firmware Forgers 
- Write low-level code for critical systems 
- Interface with sensors, actuators, and real-time controls
Loadbearers 
- Run FEA and stress analysis for airframe components 
- Design and validate composite structures
Builders' Guild 
- Develop tooling, jigs, and fast prototyping processes 
- Select and test aerospace-grade materials

Who you are 
- You don’t wait for permission to start solving problems 
- You’ve built more than simulations: rigs, drones, bikes, rockets 
- You can dive deep in one domain but jump across others when needed 
- You thrive in chaos and learn fast when things break

Bonus if you have 
- Built in student tech teams: UAV, FSAE, Rocketry, Hyperloop, Satellite, etc. 
- Tinkering experience: 3D printing, soldering, machining, hacking 
- Projects in Python, Simulink, MATLAB, C/C++, CAD, FEA, RTOS Self-initiated builds, open-source contributions, or sub-team leadership

Why LAT?
- Core team opportunity at a high-conviction deep-tech startup
- Real aircraft, real flying hardware, real impact
- Build the future of sustainable aviation in India

About Us
We are a fast-growing deep-tech aerospace company building the world’s most advanced aero engines for both military and civilian applications. Our current focus includes jet fuel-based propulsion systems for military UAVs, as well as pioneering green hydrogen–powered aero engine R&D for future aviation. Our team culture revolves around first-principles thinking, scientific rigor, and rapid innovation, and we are looking for engineers who are open-minded, technically curious, and ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in aerospace propulsion.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design and development of liquid fuel injection systems for aero engine applications
• Understanding and application of systems level modelling approach for engine design
• Development of combustors from systems level design and requirements
• Development of HPC based digital twins, employing multiphase and reactive flow models. Concept evaluation using simulation tools
• Coordinate with design and manufacturing team and vendors for successful realization of components
• Understanding of combustion test rig and experimental campaigns
• Hardware testing on test rigs followed by rapid design iterations. Engine ground testing followed by data analysis and design revisions. Setting up advanced experiments using laser diagnostics
• Understanding of liquid fuel flow systems for Jet A and high-pressure plumbing. Understanding of best practices related to high pressure plumbing lines, pressure regulation and formulation of P&IDs
• Experience with safety protocols in testing
•Coordinating with turbomachinery team for system integration.

Required Qualifications and Skills
• Masters or PhD in Aerospace or related fields, with a focus on propulsion
• Understanding of fundamental combustion and multiphase flow concepts
• Understanding of aero engine/gas turbine technologies, thermodynamic cycles and basic systems level analysis

• Demonstrated experience with multiphase/spray measurements and experiments
•Experience building fuel injection systems and combustors for aerospace applications. Understanding of basic fuel injection concepts.

Preferred Skills
• Understanding of combustion and multiphase models and commercial CFD tools
• Hands-on experience with gas turbines and aero engines
• Understanding of conjugate heat transfer and modelling techniques.
• Understanding of super alloys and materials relevant to aero engine parts
• Understanding of machining and manufacturing processes

What will you gain from this job:
• End-to-end exposure to real-world jet engine development, including control systems, hardware realization, and flight testing.
• Mentorship from experienced aerospace engineers and hands-on work with cutting-edge propulsion technologies.
• Opportunity to work on advanced aerospace R&D in high-speed transonic regimes, using both scientific and practical engineering approaches.
• A strong stepping stone toward advanced careers in propulsion, flight control, embedded systems, or aerospace research.
• Professional work environment with a five-day work week, standard benefits, and collaboration on world-class projects.

Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

About Us
We are a fast-growing deep-tech aerospace company building the world’s most advanced aero engines for both military and civilian applications. Our current focus includes jet fuel-based propulsion systems for military UAVs, as well as pioneering green hydrogen–powered aero engine R&D for future aviation. Our team culture revolves around first-principles thinking, scientific rigor, and rapid innovation, and we are looking for engineers who are open-minded, technically curious, and ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in aerospace propulsion.

Your Role
As an aero engine Control Systems Engineer, you will hold a key technical role focused on the development and implementation of the engine's core control logic. You will be responsible for the entire model-based design lifecycle, from creating adaptive control algorithms in MATLAB/Simulink to implementing them on embedded microcontrollers using C. This position requires you to perform rigorous system-level validation through both software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hands-on hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, demanding a strong practical understanding of control theory, real-time programming, and aerospace electronics.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, implement, and validate adaptive control algorithms for jet engine systems under different environmental and operational conditions.
• Develop high-fidelity analytical and simulation models of jet engine control dynamics using MATLAB/Simulink and embedded platforms.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including mechanical, thermal, and avionics engineers to ensure robust system integration and performance.
• Conduct system-level testing and validation, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and software-in-the-loop (SIL) testing.
• Provide technical support in debugging embedded hardware, including interfacing sensors, actuators, and micro-controllers.
• Document control strategies, test results, and version-controlled software using industry-standard tools.

Required Qualifications & Skills
• Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, with a focus on Control Systems or Embedded Systems for aerospace applications.
• Proficient in MATLAB/Simulink, Embedded C, and real-time microcontroller programming.
• Experience with model-based design, auto-code generation, and firmware development for aerospace or automotive systems.
• Strong understanding of digital and analogue electronics, including experience in PCB-level debugging, soldering, wiring, and instrumentation.
• Familiarity with communication protocols (e.g., CAN, SPI, UART) and sensor/actuator integration.
• Familiarity with tools like Git, Oscilloscope, Logic Analyzer, Multimeter.
• Enthusiasm for working in experimental environments involving real hardware and field testing.

Preferred Skills
• Direct experience with gas turbine engines or the development of Full Authority Digital Engine Controls (FADEC).
• Experience with flight controllers and associated firmware.
• Knowledge of safety-critical software development standards.
• Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).

What will you gain from this job:
• End-to-end exposure to real-world jet engine development, including control systems, hardware realization, and flight testing.
• Mentorship from experienced aerospace engineers and hands-on work with cutting-edge propulsion technologies.
• Opportunity to work on advanced aerospace R&D in high-speed transonic regimes, using both scientific and practical engineering approaches.
• A strong stepping stone toward advanced careers in propulsion, flight control, embedded systems, or aerospace research.
• Professional work environment with a five-day work week, standard benefits, and collaboration on world-class projects.

• Determine dynamic properties of composite structures to estimate damaging modes of operations. Carry out modal analysis and evaluate aerodynamic flutter at high speed conditions.

• Understanding of basic principles of composite structures
• Understanding of aircraft design, aero structures and aerodynamic load calculations
• Bachelor's degree/MS in aerospace or mechanical engineering; master's preferred.
• Relevant, hands-on experience in structural design and analysis in composite structures
• Understanding of aerodynamics and its impact of aero structural stresses
• Proficiency in structural analysis software (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus) for FEA analysis
• Proficiency in first principles based analytical calculations and modelling
• Basic understanding of optimization algorithms
• Basic understanding of manufacturing methods for composite structures

,,0,0,False,1764575478000,1764661863000.0,1764661863000.0,1764575515000.0,The Ola Group is a dynamic conglomerate comprising ANI Technologies, Ola Electric, and Krutrim, each contributing to our mission of redefining mobility, advancing sustainable transportation, and pioneering AI innovation.

At ANI Technologies, we operate Ola Cabs, India's leading ride-hailing platform, serving over 250 million customers across 3 continents, offering employees a fast-paced, tech-driven environment where innovation thrives. Ola Electric is at the forefront of the electric vehicle revolution, with our state-of-the-art Futurefactory in Tamil Nadu, producing over 5 million electric two-wheelers annually and creating thousands of jobs. Krutrim, our AI arm, is dedicated to developing cutting-edge artificial intelligence models and infrastructure, empowering India to lead in the digital age.

Job Summary:
The Model-Based Developer role involves designing and developing control algorithms for EV powertrain, battery management systems (BMS), Charger, Vehicle control system, ABS and its dynamics using MATLAB/Simulink, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement high-performance, production-ready embedded software solutions.

Key Result Areas:
Control Algorithm Development: Design and implement model-based control algorithms for EV powertrain, Charger, and Vehicle control systems.
Model-Based Design (MBD): Develop MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow models for embedded control applications.
Auto Code Generation & Optimization: Generate optimized Embedded C code using Embedded Coder for real-time execution.
Software Integration: Integrated model-based control strategies into vehicle ECU embedded software for production deployment.
Calibration & Parameter Tuning: Develop models with scalability and control parameters tunability for real-world vehicle applications.
Compliance & Standards: Ensure AUTOSAR, ISO 26262, and functional safety compliance in software development.
Documentation & Reviews: Maintain detailed documentation of control models, software architecture, and implementation strategies.

Competency Requirements:
B.Tech/M.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or Automotive Engineering.
MATLAB, Simulink, Stateflow – strong expertise in control model development.
Embedded Coder – auto-code generation and model optimization.
Experience in Model-in-loop, Hardware-in-loop, and Python scripting.
Knowledge of control systems and power electronics is essential.
Understanding of the vehicle electrical architecture and behaviour of electrical components in EV.
Good to have knowledge/experience in C/C++ programming, and MISRA C guidelines.
Good to have knowledge about different automotive systems (ECU software) and communication protocols (CAN, LIN, ETHERNET etc).

Perks of working with Ola:
Build technology that impacts millions at massive scale.
Work with top engineers solving complex, high-performance problems.
Exposure to cutting-edge systems across mobility, EV, and AI businesses.
High ownership and visibility with leadership.
Fast-track career growth in a high-velocity engineering environment.

,www.olaelectric.com,M.Tech in Electromagnetics, Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Robotics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, AI, or related field.",,0,0,False,1764575415000,1764661857000.0,1764661857000.0,1764575450000.0,"Job Summary:
As part of Ola’s Vehicle Engineering team, you will design, develop, and validate core EV technologies across power electronics, power systems, robotics, embedded controllers, and electromagnetics. You will work end-to-end on system architecture, hardware-software integration, and performance validation to deliver reliable, safe, and scalable systems for next-generation Ola Electric platforms.

Role 1: Power Electronics
Specialization:
Inverters, converters, onboard chargers, switching control, high-voltage EV hardware.
Key Roles & Responsibilities (KRAs):
Deliver high-efficiency inverter, converter, and onboard charging systems for next-gen Ola EVs.
Own end-to-end validation across voltage, load, thermal, and environmental stress conditions.
Optimize switching strategies, control algorithms, and protection logic to enhance range and efficiency.
Collaborate with BMS, motor control, and vehicle integration teams for system-level performance.
Drive component selection, supplier alignment, and cost optimization without compromising safety.
Qualifications & Skills:
M.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Power Engineering, or related field.
Strong understanding of HV systems, power semiconductors, converters/inverters.
Experience with validation, testing, modelling, and safety compliance for power electronics.

Role 2: Power Systems
Specialization:
Vehicle power architecture, HV/LV systems, power distribution & safety.
Key Roles & Responsibilities (KRAs):
Architect and validate complete vehicle power distribution networks.
Optimise HV/LV architecture for charging, performance, and auxiliary loads.
Lead system modelling, simulations, and FMEA for safety and stability.
Work with software, BMS, and thermal teams to enhance system-level energy efficiency.
Deliver diagnostics, protection logic, and power management strategies.
Qualifications & Skills:
Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or similar.
Expertise in HV/LV architecture, safety standards, and EV power distribution.
Strong background in simulations, modelling, and failure analysis.

Role 3: Robotics & Humanoids
Specialization:
Industrial robotics, humanoids, automation systems, motion control.
Key Roles & Responsibilities (KRAs):
Develop robotics and humanoid systems for automation and intelligent operations at the Futurefactory.
Build motion planning, perception, and actuation modules with high accuracy and responsiveness.
Integrate multi-sensor fusion, control algorithms, and safety mechanisms into production-ready systems.
Collaborate with mechanical, controls, and AI teams to scale automation throughput.
Conduct data-driven tuning, testing, and failure-mode analysis.
Qualifications & Skills:
M.Tech in Robotics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, AI, or related fields.
Strong expertise in robotics algorithms, perception, control, and sensor fusion.
Experience deploying robotics systems in real environments is preferred.

Role 4: Embedded Systems
Specialization:
Embedded firmware, ECU development, automotive-grade software.
Key Roles & Responsibilities (KRAs):
Develop production-grade firmware for vehicle ECUs ensuring deterministic and reliable performance.
Own feature development, board bring-up, driver integration, and firmware optimization.
Collaborate with hardware, software, and diagnostics teams to ensure seamless system integration.
Implement safety, cybersecurity, and OTA-ready frameworks.
Improve memory efficiency, latency, power usage, and fault recovery mechanisms.
Qualifications & Skills:
Master’s Degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or similar.
Strong knowledge of C/C++, RTOS, microcontrollers, and automotive communication protocols.
Experience in embedded testing, debugging, and safety-compliant firmware development.

Role 5: Electromagnetics
Specialization:
Motor EM design, antenna systems, EMC/EMI simulation & compliance.
Key Roles & Responsibilities (KRAs):
Lead EM design, simulation, and validation for motors, antennas, and wireless systems.
Ensure EMC/EMI compliance and regulatory adherence across all vehicle operating conditions.
Build EM models and run optimisation to improve performance and reduce noise/EM interference.
Collaborate with powertrain, connectivity, and integration teams to resolve EM issues.
Deliver test procedures, mitigation strategies, and documentation for certification.
Qualifications & Skills:
M.Tech in Electromagnetics, Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, or similar.
Experience with EM simulation tools, EMC/EMI testing, and regulatory standards.
Strong understanding of motor design, wireless systems, and interference mitigation.

Perks of working with Ola:
Work on cutting-edge EV and robotics technologies that shape the future of mobility.
Collaborate with top engineers and leaders across world-class R&D and manufacturing teams.
Own high-impact charters with direct visibility to senior leadership.
Access advanced labs, testing infrastructure, and next-gen engineering tools.
Accelerated growth in a fast-paced, innovation-first environment.

We are driving innovation in next-generation automotive platforms, delivering cutting-edge solutions for ADAS, Fusion, and zonal architectures. Our team works on Renesas R-Car SoCs, enabling high-performance, low-power automotive systems with advanced AI capabilities.
Role Overview
As an Embedded Software Developer, you will design, develop, and optimize software across the entire stack—from secure bootloaders to AI-driven applications—on R-Car SoCs.
This role demands strong expertise in embedded systems, performance tuning, and AI optimization for automotive-grade platforms.
Key Responsibilities
• Develop Bootloader, Linux, Android and QNX enablement for multi-core SoCs.
• Implement fast boot strategies and optimize boot time for automotive use cases.
• Design and implement software for heterogeneous compute units (CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU).
• Optimize low-level drivers and middleware for performance and reliability.

About Us
Augnito is the next gen Voice AI powering the healthcare industry. Augnito empowers medical professionals and streamlined clinical workflows with cloud-based, AI speech recognition that offers ergonomic data entry with 99% accuracy, without the need for voice profile training, from any device, anywhere.
From the outset, Augnito was built in close partnership with clinicians, using human-centered design, to create an AI natural language processing engine to fit your needs – not the other way around. As a result, Augnito offers excellent support for a wide variety of clinical vocabulary and workflows and can halve your clinical reporting and admin time, increase revenue, prevent physician burnout, eliminate transcription waiting delays, and enable you to focus your energy on patient care – not documentation. Augnito is currently deployed at 300+ hospitals and health systems and has a growing presence in 20+ countries, including the US, UK and Canada

About the role:
As a Speech Engineer at Augnito you will play a pivotal role in you will play a pivotal role in the development of our AI-driven speech recognition and language understanding systems. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing speech-related algorithms and technologies that power our products. This position requires a deep understanding of speech processing, machine learning, and natural language understanding, as well as the ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced, and dynamic startup environment.

Responsibilities:
• Design and implement Hybrid and/or End-to-End speech and language processing system using machine learning and deep learning techniques.
• Preprocess, annotate, and manage large datasets of speech and text for training and testing purposes.
• Develop data augmentation techniques to improve model robustness and generalization.
• Train and fine-tune speech recognition and language understanding models.
• Implement and experiment with state-of-the-art algorithms to optimize model performance.
• Conduct rigorous evaluation of speech models and provide insights for model improvement.
• Collaborate with product managers and engineers to understand user requirements and provide technical solutions.
• Ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations in projects.
• Stay updated with state-of-the-art techniques in the Speech Recognition field and exchange knowledge with colleagues.
• Coordinate with internal teams to translate business challenges into data pipelines and model frameworks.
• Document research findings, methodologies, and implementation details.
• Communicate progress and results to the team and stakeholders effectively.

Qualifications:
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field from leading research institutes.
• Knowledge with speech technologies like Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Multilingual Speech Recognition, Diarization, Language Model, Pronunciation Model, Audio classification.
• Hands-on experience in building Hybrid speech recognition systems like GMM-HMM, DNN-HMM
• Hands-on experience in building end-to-end speech recognition systems using the latest architectures like wav2vec2, HuBERT, Whisper, LAS.
• Familiarity with machine learning and deep learning libraries such as Scikit Learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
• Strong programming experience in languages like Python, C/C++, Shell scripting etc.
• Experience contributing to research communities, including publications at conferences and/or journals (a plus)

Location: Mumbai
Type: On-site (Full Time)
We are looking for a creative Data Scientist to join our team! An extremely important role for our success.
As a member of the development team, your responsibilities will include transfer learning and training LLMs. Ideal candidates will have a strong data science background and can help us build/fine-tune LLMs.
You'll have the opportunity to work with large-scale data sets and turn your insights into real products. You'll be an integral part in how we understand user behavior, identify and recommend product opportunities, which are all critical to how we can scale our ever-growing user base.

Responsibilities:
● Fine-tune LLM for Q&A, NLP, multi-labeling, image detection, emotion detection, etc.
● Modifies and analyzes complex data sets using analytics techniques such as machine learning, statistical analysis, Natural Language Processing, Identifies modeling attributes and parameters. Applies algorithms to create descriptive, predictive or prescriptive models to achieve analysis and project deliverables.
● Investigates data characteristics, complexity, quality, and meaning. Through visualizations and summarizations, defines performance, identifies trends, outliers, and drivers.
● Prepares data for analysis, e.g. cleansing, conditioning, transforming, handling missing fields, identifying new feature variables and handling multi-variate data.

Required Skills:
● Experience in fine-tuning and training LLM.
● Experience of training models for Topic Modeling, Multi-labeling data science solutions.
● Experience in relevant programming languages (e.g. Python)
● Experience within the Python Data Science ecosystem - NumPy, SciPy, Jupyter, etc.
● BTech / MTech / MSc in Computer Science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, or other technical fields. Advanced degrees preferred. Provide a link to a Github that showcases your work.
Bonus Skills:
● Experience building deep neural networks to production.
● Experience in Sage Maker, AWS, Google cloud
● Experience with large volume data processing systems
● Experience with Agile software development
● Good knowledge of Database technologies such as SQL, PL/SQL and relational database schema design

Why join us?
● A team that is invested in your career growth and training
● Competitive salary, based on experience
● Work alongside world-class talent
● Flexible vacation / paid time off policy
● Personal style encouraged

all employees.

Specialist – Compensation & Performance Management Tools
Function
Human Resources – Compensation & Benefits / HR Analytics
Location
Bengaluru
About MBRDI
Mercedes-Benz Research and Development India (MBRDI) is the largest R&D center of Mercedes-Benz Group outside Germany. We work on end-to-end automotive engineering, digitalization, and people solutions that power the future of mobility.
Role Summary
This role is responsible for managing, configuring, and enhancing compensation and performance management tools across the organization. The incumbent will work closely with HR Business Partners, business stakeholders, HRIS teams, and BI developers to ensure smooth execution of merit cycles, performance dashboards, and customized BI solutions, while maintaining governance, accuracy, and user experience.

Key Responsibilities
1. Compensation Tools & Merit Cycle Management (30%)
Execute the annual merit hike cycle end-to-end through PeopleSoft, including tool configuration and integration with Tableau BI.
Set up and manage merit hike parameters such as budget allocation, hike ranges, eligibility rules, and guideline logic.
Enable and manage integration between PeopleSoft and Tableau BI in collaboration with HRIS and BI development teams.
Configure customized rules in Tableau BI, including eligibility and governance checks.
Collect feedback from HRBPs and business stakeholders and translate it into actionable enhancements for BI dashboards.
Prepare and maintain merit cycle documentation including guidelines, tool guides, checklists, and meeting minutes.
Conduct periodic tool health checks and ensure documentation completeness.
Provide timely manager and HR support for queries, tool issues, and clarifications during the merit cycle.
Support HRBPs, staffing consultants, and line managers on C&B processes, ensuring compliance with governance frameworks.

2. Performance Management Tools (15%)
Manually refresh performance management dashboards on a daily basis.
Collate data from multiple sources and upload it to defined repositories for dashboard refresh.
Assist in preparing and maintaining performance management guidelines and documentation.
Gather feedback from HRBPs and business stakeholders and share enhancement requirements with BI development teams.
Develop customized Power BI / Tableau dashboards within short timelines based on evolving business needs.
Prepare performance management tool setup documents and user guides.
Provide quick turnaround support to managers and HR teams for tool-related queries and issues.

3. HR Tool & HRIS Module Support (15%)
Support HRBP colleagues with data extraction and maintenance of compensation and related HRIS modules.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and adherence to governance standards.
Provide structured feedback on tool enhancements and issues to HRIS and development teams.

4. Customized BI Development & Product Ownership (40%)
Independently design and develop customized Tableau dashboards using advanced Tableau / Power BI capabilities.
Leverage strong understanding of HRIS data structures and HR functional processes to deliver business-ready insights.
Act as product owner for Tableau dashboards developed by other teams and integrated into HR systems.
Review dashboard outputs, provide functional feedback, and act as the business analyst for BI initiatives.
Ensure dashboards are scalable, intuitive, and aligned with HR and business requirements.

Key Skills & Competencies
Strong hands-on experience with PeopleSoft HR modules.
Advanced proficiency in Tableau and Power BI.
Solid understanding of HR processes, especially Compensation & Performance Management.
Strong data handling, validation, and documentation skills.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical BI solutions.
Stakeholder management and clear communication skills.
High attention to detail and governance compliance.
Ability to work under tight timelines during critical HR cycles.

Experience & Qualification
Relevant experience in HR systems, compensation tools, or HR analytics.
Experience working with large datasets and enterprise HR systems preferred.
Exposure to global HR processes and governance frameworks is an advantage.

Lead Engineer, Electronic Hardware

Job Description:

We at SEDEMAC are on the look-out for a Hardware Design Engineer to join our stellar Electronic Hardware team.

Major Responsibilities:

• The candidate is expected to lead a small team of Hardware engineers working closely with cross functions such as Systems/Software Engineering, Product Validation, Manufacturing, Product Costing etc.
• Single point of contact for cross functional engineering team for product specific hardware development initiatives.
• Defines and manages changes to hardware product requirements.
• Leads product feasibility assessment activities.
• Selection of major components considering competing constraints such as costing, performance, reliability, availability etc.
• Proactively assesses and treats high severity failure modes during the design phase to achieve industry leading product reliability.
• Performs worst case design simulations / calculations & prototype studies to ensure compliance to requirements.
• Defines and communicates HW-SW, HW-Mechanical interface requirements and constraints.
• Assesses and communicates risks associated with design trade-offs.
• Defines PCB constraints.
• Supports development of manufacturing SOPs, EOL test rigs.
• Defines hardware verification plan & amp; performs V&V activities.
• Leads design implementation activities working closely with CAD engineers.
• Represents HW team for RCA activities and ensures implementation of CAPA during the complete HW product lifecycle.
• Proactively identifies and implements opportunities to minimize BOM cost and improve product robustness and reliability.
• Technically mentors junior team members.
• Conducts internal product training & sharing of LLBP and technical knowhow.

Technical Skills & Experience:

• Requirements analysis.
• Product architecture definition, Component selection.
• Design calculation & simulation, Worst Case Analysis, Component derating.
• Thermal analysis, Signal Integrity Analysis.
• Functional/Piece Part FMEA, DRBFM.
• PCB design, DFM, DFT, DFR aspects.
• Usage of lab equipment like DSO/MSO, Function generators, Power supplies etc.
• Failure root cause analysis - 8D, 3x5 Why methodologies.
• Experience in hands-on development of analog/embedded circuits, validation, industrialization, and series maintenance of medium/high complexity products, preferably in Automotive / Transportation / Aerospace or similar industries.
• Hands on experience in reliability prediction, compliance testing is preferable.
• Exposure to development of High Power DC-DC Converters, Motor drives is an added advantage.

Managerial Skills & Experience:

• Collaborative and effective teamwork.
• Ownership and sense of urgency.
• Good judgement and attention to details.
• Good written and verbal communication.

Information on Selection Process:

• The selection process will be multi-phased tests plus interviews.
• There will be a focus on evaluation of the candidate’s understanding of electronic Hardware Design, analytical & logical skills.

Educational Requirement:

• PhD in Electrical / Electronics Engineering (CGPA 6.0+ or 60% throughout)

About SEDEMAC

At its core, SEDEMAC is the convergence of talented engineers committed to the development and large-scale deployment of innovative control technologies and products. As one of the fastest-growing Tier-1 suppliers in the automotive space, we work with vehicle, motor, and engine manufacturers who are leaders in their own space to deliver fundamental control solutions with real-world impact. Our engineer-led organization prides itself on creating technology propositions and taking them from the drawing board to high-volume production with operational excellence. We foster a culture that values creativity, honesty, and respect—where ideas are judged by their merit, not by hierarchy. With a strong foundation and ambitious growth plans, SEDEMAC is uniquely positioned to shape the future of controls.

Job Description:

The primary role of the candidate is to lead a team of PCB engineers, wherein the team is responsible to perform PCB layout of electronic controllers designed at SEDEMAC, while coordinating with an interdisciplinary team comprising circuit design engineers, mechanical design engineers and manufacturing engineers. The electronic controllers designed at SEDEMAC are typically those involving mixed signal circuits and power electronics for automotive, generator set and telematics applications.

• Customer Requirement Understanding: Proficient in interpreting and meeting internal and external customer specifications for automotive and off-highway applications, and relevant for PCBs manufactured into large volumes.
• Project, Resource and Program Management: Effectively allocate PCB engineers and manage projects in SEDEMAC's dynamic environment, adapting to frequent priority changes.
• Team Leadership and Training: Lead and mentor the PCB layout team, developing training modules and white papers to enhance their skills and knowledge
• PCB Design Proficiency: Expertise in managing component libraries as per IPC, drafting detailed schematics, and designing innovative PCB layouts with a focus on manufacturability and size constraints. • Gerber and Panelling: Skilled in generating accurate Gerber files, performing efficient panelling, and collaborating with PCB suppliers to address technical queries and ensure seamless manufacturing processes.

• PCB Root Cause Analysis and Quality Check: Skilled in conducting thorough root cause analysis and quality checks to quickly identify and resolve PCB-related issues. Develop and use systematic review checklists to maintain high design standards and ensure reliability.
• Statutory and Regulatory Awareness: Good understanding of automotive industry-specific statutory and regulatory requirements, ensuring designs meet relevant standards and regulations in accordance with customer specifications.

• Proficiency in a PCB CAD tools (PADs Professional and Gerber Logix is a plus, while knowledge of Eagle, Corel and Saturn is also mildly desirable)
• Knowledge of 7QC Tools: Proficiency in applying the 7QC tools, such as checklists and observation graphs, for effective quality control and continuous improvement initiatives.

Educational Requirement:

• PhD in Electrical / Electronics Engineering (CGPA 6.0+ or 60% throughout)

Our engineer-led organization prides itself on creating technology propositions and taking them from the drawing board to high-volume production with operational excellence. India is at an inflection point in manufacturing and sustainability. Over the next decade, a large share of global production will shift towards cleaner, local, and more resilient supply chains. Biomanufacturing will be a core pillar of that shift.
Lemnisca is building the AI-first backbone for this transition – starting with precision fermentation. We combine biology, chemical engineering and data/AI to make fermentation processes:
• Faster to develop
• Smoother to scale
• More predictable across sites and scales
Our goal is to enable companies in India and globally to manufacture high-value molecules from renewable feedstocks, reliably and competitively. From personal care to food and health, we want everyday products to be made more sustainably – with India not just participating, but leading.
As part of the early team, you will help turn this vision into operating reality: real processes, real customers, real plants.

Mission for this role
The Bioprocess Modeling lead will develop Lemnisca’s bioprocess modeling capability, focused on supporting fermentation and downstream process development across the lab-to-industrial continuum. The mission of this role is to build robust computational models that help bridge experimental results and reliable process operation.
This is a founding leadership role with significant influence on technical direction. You will work closely with the Bioengineering team to establish effective practices for integrating experimental data and computational models, ensuring that modeling outputs directly inform process development and decision-making.

What you will do
• Develop and maintain bioprocess models that support fermentation and downstream process development across laboratory and early industrial settings.
• Work closely with the Bioengineering team to define modeling questions, design informative experiments, and interpret experimental data through a modeling lens.
• Translate experimental and process data into predictive insights that guide development decisions and reduce uncertainty during process scale-up.
• Establish standards for model development, validation, documentation, and reuse within the company.
• Build and maintain data workflows that connect experimental results with computational analysis in a reliable and traceable manner.

interesting problems in the video domain. We are India’s number one SaaS company . We offer you the
opportunity to work on cutting edge technologies that shape the way viewers watch streaming TV.
Job Profile: We are looking for an ML Engineers to work on applied R&D problems across vision, NLP,
and agentic AI systems. This role is hands-on and deeply technical—you will design, implement, train, and
iterate on models from first principles, and translate research ideas into robust, working systems. You will
work closely with senior researchers and engineers on real-world, high-impact AI systems rather than toy
problems or narrow benchmarks.
Work Mode: In Office
Location: Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)

Key Responsibilities
● Design and implement neural architectures from scratch for vision, NLP, or multimodal
problems
● Train, evaluate, and iterate on deep learning models using PyTorch
● Build agentic systems that combine reasoning, planning, memory, and tool use
● Develop advanced LLM-based systems, including:
○ Sophisticated context engineering
○ Prompt strategies beyond basic prompting (multi-stage, self-reflective, tool-augmented
flows)
● Work extensively in Jupyter notebooks for experimentation, analysis, and rapid prototyping
● Conduct experiments, analyze failure modes, and improve models systematically
● Read and implement ideas from recent research papers when needed
● Collaborate with product and systems teams to move from prototype to usable systems
Required Qualifications
● Fresher/ 2–3 years of industry experience working in one or more of:Computer Vision
(image / video)
● NLP / Language Models
● Multimodal or agentic AI systems
● Strong experience building models from scratch, not just using pre-trained APIs
● Deep hands-on expertise in:
○ Python
○ PyTorch
○ Jupyter notebooks
● Solid understanding of:Neural network architectures
● Training dynamics, optimization, and eval\ation
● Practical experience with LLMs beyond basic usage
● Strong problem-solving ability and comfort with ambiguity
● Undergraduate/ Post Graduate from B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD Research in Computer Science
(or closely related field) from a top-tier institution

Good to Have
● Experience with video understanding or temporal models
● Sufficient background to read, comprehend, and apply ideas from latest research papers in
the AI/ML domain
● Familiarity with research workflows and ablation-driven experimentation
● Prior work on productionizing research prototypes
● Comfort working in fast-moving, research-heavy environments


What We Value
● First-principles thinking over library-driven development
● Depth of understanding over surface-level familiarity
● Engineers who can reason about models, not just run them
● Curiosity, rigor, and ownership of complex problems
Benefits: Our benefits are designed to support not just your role, but your life beyond it. From
comprehensive insurance coverage and inclusive leave policies to wellness programs that focus
on mental, physical, and financial well-being, Employees also enjoy on-site meals at the office,
creating a more comfortable and energising workday. We aim to create an environment that
enables you to thrive.
Amagi Culture: At Amagi, our culture is defined by the "Amagi Way"—a high-performance
environment where Goodness Wins and collective success takes precedence over individual
ego. We are a team of independent thinkers who think Macro, Do The Micro, combining vision
with a relentless obsession for the technical details that power the new video economy. We
believe that a lean group of elite talent achieves more than massive, fragmented teams, and we
foster this by encouraging everyone to Be Vulnerable, Be You—bringing your authentic self to
a space built on trust and transparency. We move fast, act pragmatically, and Have Fun with
Challenges, ensuring that every innovative solution we dream up is built, delivered, and
impactful. Joining Amagi means embracing the freedom to innovate while being part of a global
mission rooted in integrity and transformative purpose.

SEDEMAC Mechatronics Limited

Engineer, Embedded Software

About the job

Our products are heavily reliant on embedded software, and hence we are inviting passionate individuals to join our team to contribute towards our pursuit of building world-class products for the future. You would be a key player of the team responsible for crafting world-class software that goes into high-scale products built by SEDEMAC. This is an opportunity to create impact, the code you write will go into millions of products we ship annually. You will be a part of a peer group that will encourage and inspire you to improve.

Major Responsibilities

“Engineer, Embedded Software” at SEDEMAC is responsible for end-to-end design, development and testing of embedded software stack within a particular product line in SEDEMAC. The candidate is required to:
1. Be responsible for software development for product lines such as “traction controllers”, “fuel injection controllers”, “generator set controllers” etc.
2. Ensure timely and high-quality software delivery, in co-ordination with system engineers and electronic engineers who are responsible for their respective domains of the product development.
3. Act as the first point of contact for internal and external customers. Typically, the internal customers of software team would be the system engineering team who are product owners.
4. De-risk crucial show-stoppers in the project, involving development of complex logics, and resolving complex defects (RCAs). This also includes the candidate participating in post-production failures of the product.
5. Actively participate in improving software development process, workflows, technologies used at SEDEMAC and ensure compliance with software development standards as relevant to the product line that the engineer is driving.
6. Perform code reviews; have a keen eye for suspecting and spotting potential errors.
7. Ensure thorough, high-quality documentation of the software artefacts developed, and also participate in development of white-papers to improve the state of software team’s knowledge repository.

Required Skills & Experience

• Software development experience in embedded software development in C and preferably C++.
• Comfort with Python scripting is good to have.
• Experience with RTOS is a plus.
• Good knowledge of microcontrollers and hands-on with IDEs, debuggers, emulators etc.
• Comfort with Git is desired.
• Excellent spoken and written English communication.

Information on Selection Process

• The selection process will be multi-phased tests plus interviews.
• There will be focus on evaluation of your understanding of embedded software skills, logical & analytical skills.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics & Telecommunication, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Robotics, Mechanical only

About SEDEMAC

At its core, SEDEMAC is the convergence of talented engineers committed to the development and large-scale deployment of innovative control technologies and products. As one of the fastest-growing Tier-1 suppliers in the automotive space, we work with vehicle, motor, and engine manufacturers who are leaders in their own space to deliver fundamental control solutions with real-world impact. Our engineer-led organization prides itself on creating technology propositions and taking them from the drawing board to high-volume production with operational excellence. We foster a culture that values creativity, honesty, and respect—where ideas are judged by their merit, not by hierarchy. With a strong foundation and ambitious growth plans, SEDEMAC is uniquely positioned to shape the future of controls.

Applied Science Works, Bengaluru
________________________________________
About Us
Applied Science Works is a U.S.-based company currently in the process of establishing its knowledge center in India, with its headquarters in Bangalore. The organization’s mission is to address ab initio materials design challenges by integrating physics-based modelling, AI-driven heuristics, and human expertise, thereby reducing exascale search spaces to practical, experimentally actionable outcomes. With a strong focus on R&D and innovation, Applied Science Works envisions combining AI-led discovery with applied sciences to accelerate materials research and technological innovation.
What are we looking for?
We are seeking for the right candidates to join our R&D team as Research Scientist & Engineer.
In this role, the selected candidate will work at the intersection of materials research, technology development, and innovation and will be responsible for designing and executing experiments, optimizing processes, and collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams to translate scientific discoveries into practical, real-world solutions.
The Responsibilities
• Design and execute research projects in materials synthesis, characterization, and process optimization
• Develop novel experimental techniques and integrate innovative technologies into research workflows
• Analyze experimental data and develop predictive models using computational and AI-based techniques
• Automate initiatives, dataset development, and laboratory infrastructure setup
• Troubleshoot technical challenges and ensure effective delivery
• Maintain rigorous safety and compliance standards

Required Qualification:
• Master’s or higher degree (M.Sc,M.Tech,PhD) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
• Hands-on R&D experience (freshers to 5+ years depending on role specialization)
• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and learning skills
• Expertise in one or more areas: materials synthesis, characterization techniques (microscopy, spectroscopy, diffraction), process development, or data analysis
• Laboratory experience with complex instrumentation and experimental design
• Effective teamwork and communication skills
• Strong safety mindset and responsibility
Preferred:
• PhD in Chemistry, Physics, or Materials Science
• Advanced synthesis expertise (PVD, sputtering, PLD, MBE, CVD)
• High-throughput or AI-driven materials discovery experience
• Publications or recognized field contributions
• Automation scripting, LIMS, or Python/MATLAB experience
• Work with national user facilities (synchrotrons, neutron sources)
• Startup or fast-paced R&D environment experience

Our Offer
• Competitive salary, aligned with industry standards and commensurate with experience
• Comprehensive employee benefits package, including health insurance and statutory benefits
• Cutting-edge research and innovation projects with real-world impact
• Collaborative and supportive team environment that values knowledge sharing
• Rapid skill development across diverse technical and scientific domains
• Dynamic startup culture with flexibility, ownership, and a strong learning focus
• Strong commitment to safety, well-being, and long-term professional growth
• Bengaluru-based role with access to a vibrant and globally connected technology ecosystem

How to apply
Email resume, cover letter, and brief description of research interests/technical expertise. Highlight relevant projects and techniques. Share link: LinkedIn, GitHub, scholar.google.com

Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential and excitement for the journey ahead.
As an Applied Sciences Specialist, you will help instantiate new technology into production by advancing the state-of-the-art internally and externally to address product needs. You will act as the “and” in R&D by blending techniques of both researchers and development teams to drive innovation from theory into reality. This opportunity will allow you to work on the design, development, execution and implementation of technology research projects in collaboration with Research Scientists, software engineers, program managers and others, either serving as a catalyst for technology transfer into products and services or architecting and engineering such products and services directly.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
You will gain an understanding of the latest research related to Microsoft products or business groups and assists in technology transfer attempts, contributing to patents, co-authoring white papers, developing or maintaining tools/services for internal Microsoft use, or consulting for product or business groups.
You will gain an understanding of a broad area of research (e.g., Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Statistical Modeling, Data-Driven Insights) and the corresponding literature and applicable research techniques.
You will help reinforce a positive environment by learning and adopting best practices and maintain or develop ties with external network of peers and identify prospective talent for Microsoft research pipelines, when asked.
You will assist with documentation for senior team members as requested and participate in the creation of informal documentation as well as follow ethics and privacy policies when executing research processes and/or collecting data/information.
You will prepare data to be used for analysis by reviewing criteria that reflect quality and technical constraints and review data and suggests data to be included and excluded to address data quality problems
You will embody our culture and values.
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Doctorate Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Exxon Mobil Corporation (ExxonMobil), one of the world’s largest publicly traded international energy providers and petrochemical companies, creates solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs.
Our Businesses and Operations
The corporation’s primary businesses – Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions - provide products that enable modern life, including energy, chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. ExxonMobil holds an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the world.
• Upstream Company
The Upstream Company is where it all begins – where the story of safely and responsibly meeting global demand for energy starts. Across the upstream, our geologists, engineers and scientists work tirelessly to explore for and develop oil and natural gas using innovation and industry-leading technology.
• Product Solutions Company
The Product Solutions Company engineers, manufactures and delivers products needed by modern society at an industry-leading scale, serving multiple segments, products and markets. It will play a critical role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and plastic waste by developing more sustainable products such as lower-emission fuels, chemical performance products and next-generation lubricants and plastics.
• Low Carbon Solutions
Low Carbon Solutions is focused on commercializing lower-emission business opportunities in carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and lower-emission fuels, by leveraging the skills, knowledge and scale of ExxonMobil. The company has more than 30 years of experience capturing CO2 and has cumulatively captured more human-made CO2 than any other company.
ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India - Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region
 ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engages in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across Chemicals and Lubricants businesses. Planning teams in India are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.
 ExxonMobil’s affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.
 The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.
ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.
To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.
Job Description
We are looking for talented individuals for a diverse set of technical-focused roles in the Wells Engineering teams to support ExxonMobil’s global portfolio of Deepwater, Conventional, Unconventional & Heavy Oil assets.
Bengaluru Technology Center
Our technology center provides a range of technical support services for ExxonMobil’s global projects and operations. The current job openings are in reservoir engineering disciplines to support optimal operations, and asset development by leveraging fundamental engineering skills.
Responsibilities of these roles include, but are not limited to:
 Design and plan safe, efficient, and cost-effective well program for a variety of drilling environments.
 Monitor and analyze drilling, completions and well management data to enhance performance, reduce non-productive time, and ensure safety and regulatory compliance.
 Support real-time operation by troubleshooting drilling, completions and well management challenges and providing engineering solutions.
 Collaborate with a cross-functional team including reservoir, geoscience and production team to provide integrated solutions.
 Prepare and review technical reposts, operational summaries and post drill/completion/well-work analyses to capture learning and drive continuous improvements.
 Contribute to the development and implementation of advanced drilling, completions, well management technologies and engineering practices.
 Ensure adherence to ExxonMobil’s drilling standards, completions & well management standards, HSE polices and industry regulations.

We are Spyne, redefining how cars are marketed and sold with cutting-edge Generative AI. What started as a bold idea—using AI-powered visuals to help dealers sell online faster—has evolved into a full-fledged AI-first automotive retail ecosystem.
Backed by $16M in Series A funding from Vertex Ventures, Accel, and other top investors, we’re scaling fast:
✔ Expanded across the US & EU markets
✔ Launched industry-first AI-powered Image & 360 solutions
✔ Achieved a 5X revenue surge in 15 months, aiming for 3-4X growth this year
Now, we’re rolling out an end-to-end GenAI Automotive Retail Suite and pushing into the US market to bring our AI-driven products to 3,000-4,000 dealers.

What are we looking for?
We’re hiring a Senior Applied AI Researcher – Computer Vision to lead the next generation of Generative and 3D AI models for automotive retail.
You’ll design, train, and deploy production-grade deep learning systems that turn raw visual data into realistic, market-ready imagery for thousands of dealerships worldwide.
📍 Location: Gurugram (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
💼 Role: Full-time | 0 - 3 years of experience

What will you do?
Lead Model Development: Architect and optimize deep learning models for image synthesis, enhancement, segmentation, and 3D scene understanding.
Advance Generative AI: Fine-tune and innovate on diffusion and GAN architectures for photorealistic image generation, inpainting, and visual consistency.
3D Vision Innovation: Work on NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting, multi-view geometry, and depth estimation for realistic 3D reconstruction.
Model Optimization & Deployment: Ensure scalable, low-latency deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, and ONNX in cloud production environments.
Integrate AI Techniques: Blend diffusion models, transformers, and GANs for controllable image generation pipelines.
Post-Processing & Ranking: Develop quality metrics and ranking algorithms to evaluate and improve visual outputs.
Research Awareness: Stay on top of cutting-edge vision research and translate it into production-ready systems.
Mentor & Collaborate: Guide junior engineers, collaborate with product and data teams, and drive end-to-end innovation.
 
What will make you successful in this role?
Strong grasp of Generative AI — diffusion models, GANs, and hybrid architectures.
Experience in 3D Computer Vision — NeRFs, depth estimation, or multi-view geometry.
Deep proficiency with PyTorch, OpenCV, and image transformation frameworks.
Comfort deploying and scaling models across AWS/GCP/Azure using Docker/Kubernetes.
Ability to optimize for real-time performance, profiling, and latency reduction.
Research mindset with strong analytical and debugging instincts.
Collaborative communication — can translate complex AI into product impact.
What you must have
BTech / MTech / MS in Computer Science, AI, or related field (Tier-1/Tier-2 preferred)
3–5 years of hands-on experience in Computer Vision, Generative AI, or 3D Deep Learning
Production experience with Diffusion/GANs, 3D reconstruction, transformers, or scene understanding
Strong command over Python, PyTorch, and cloud-based deployment stacks

Why Spyne?
Real-world AI at scale - build models that touch millions of car listings.
Fast-track growth - high autonomy, direct impact, zero bureaucracy.
Research + Product fusion - space to experiment, pressure to ship.
A-Grade team - work with top-tier AI engineers and product minds.
Tools & compute - everything you need for serious experimentation.
Employee-first culture - full health coverage, transparent growth paths, and ownership opportunities.

o Research output and trajectory
